The RX-78-2 is the prototype Gundam entrusted to Amuro Ray in the Federation–Zeon conflict. Its recognizable silhouette has inspired many later designs.

Further background: The RX-78-2 is the prototype Earth Federation mobile suit piloted by Amuro Ray during the One Year War. Designed under Project V, it demonstrates how a high-performance mobile suit can change the balance of a conflict dominated by the Principality of Zeon. Its beam rifle, beam sabers and shield became visual signatures of the Gundam line, while Amuro’s growing ability as a pilot gives the machine a central place in Universal Century history.

kits.name: Freedom Gundam (HGCE)
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Kira Yamato pilots the nuclear-powered Freedom Gundam, an advanced ZAFT-built mobile suit equipped for high-mobility combat and simultaneous attacks on multiple targets.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
This HGCE Freedom Gundam represents the original Freedom design in a modern High Grade format. Its winged backpack and signature ranged weapons define the silhouette.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The wings and layered backpack give Freedom a broad outline even at smaller scales. Its distinctive equipment includes shoulder cannons, railguns and beam armaments. Differing grades and later redesigns can have different proportions and engineering; do not confuse the original Freedom with Strike Freedom, Rising Freedom or Mighty Strike Freedom.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: This HGCE Freedom Gundam represents the original Freedom design in a modern High Grade format.
kits.lore:
Kira Yamato pilots the nuclear-powered Freedom Gundam, an advanced ZAFT-built mobile suit equipped for high-mobility combat and simultaneous attacks on multiple targets.

Further background: Freedom Gundam is a ZAFT-built high-performance mobile suit that becomes Kira Yamato’s principal machine during the later stages of Gundam SEED. Powered by a nuclear reactor, it combines extreme mobility with powerful multi-target ranged attacks. The spread of its wings, shoulder-mounted cannons and railguns makes it one of the series’ most recognizable silhouettes.

kits.name: Moon Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Moon Gundam appears in the Universal Century manga and is associated with Newtype technology and a distinctive crescent-like arrangement of psycho plates behind its body.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG model emphasizes the unusually large rear psycho-plate arrangement, making the silhouette very different from a conventional Gundam.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large crescent psycho-plates are Moon Gundam’s most important visual feature. Their placement and display possibilities should be checked against the chosen kit’s included supports and parts. Its red-and-white design is distinct from the blue-and-white ν or Hi-ν families.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG model emphasizes the unusually large rear psycho-plate arrangement, making the silhouette very different from a conventional Gundam.
kits.lore:
Moon Gundam appears in the Universal Century manga and is associated with Newtype technology and a distinctive crescent-like arrangement of psycho plates behind its body.

Further background: Moon Gundam is a Universal Century mobile suit from the Moon Gundam story, combining technology and political tensions that bridge earlier Zeon-era development with later events around Char’s resurgence. Its striking red crescent-shaped equipment above the backpack is associated with psycho-plate technology, giving the design both a memorable profile and a connection to Newtype-oriented remote systems.

kits.name: Ξ Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The Xi Gundam is a large, advanced mobile suit used by Hathaway Noa under the name Mafty. Its Minovsky flight capability enables sustained atmospheric movement.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG release captures the Xi Gundam’s unusually broad, angular armor and large scale relative to typical 1/144 Gundam kits.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Xi has an unusually broad silhouette, stacked body armor and equipment associated with advanced in-atmosphere mobility. It should be identified separately from Penelope, which has a distinctly different flight unit configuration. Large HG releases require particular attention to shelf and display space.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG release captures the Xi Gundam’s unusually broad, angular armor and large scale relative to typical 1/144 Gundam kits.
kits.lore:
The Xi Gundam is a large, advanced mobile suit used by Hathaway Noa under the name Mafty. Its Minovsky flight capability enables sustained atmospheric movement.

Further background: Ξ Gundam is a high-performance mobile suit associated with Hathaway Noa’s actions as Mafty in Mobile Suit Gundam Hathaway. Its unusual form combines the powerful presence of a large Gundam-type suit with flight-related technology that changes the tactical assumptions of mobile suit combat. The design’s complex layered armor and heavy shoulders separate it from traditional Federation Gundams.

kits.name: Penelope
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The Penelope combines the Odysseus Gundam with an external flight unit, giving the Federation machine an enormous, bird-like profile.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG kit focuses on the Penelope’s layered flight-unit armor and dramatic bulk. It should not be confused with an Odysseus Gundam-only configuration.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Fixed Flight Unit gives Penelope its prominent head-like forward assembly, layered wings and enormous body volume. When evaluating a kit, distinguish the full Penelope configuration from the underlying Odysseus Gundam and confirm which conversion or display options the edition includes.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG kit focuses on the Penelope’s layered flight-unit armor and dramatic bulk.
kits.lore:
The Penelope combines the Odysseus Gundam with an external flight unit, giving the Federation machine an enormous, bird-like profile.

Further background: Penelope is a large flight-capable mobile suit deployed by the Earth Federation in Gundam Hathaway, associated with pilot Lane Aim. Its Odysseus Gundam core and Fixed Flight Unit create a striking armored exterior, and its encounters with Mafty’s Ξ Gundam define the story’s airborne mobile suit battles. The machine’s distinctive shape comes from the integrated flight equipment rather than from a conventional Gundam silhouette.

kits.name: Nightingale
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack - Beltorchika's Children
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The Nightingale is a massive red mobile suit associated with Char Aznable in the Beltorchika’s Children continuity, with a broad frame and remote funnel weapons.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG kit translates the machine’s exceptionally wide shoulders, rear armor, and unusual proportions into a large 1/144 display model.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The rear binders, broad torso and elaborate thruster assemblies dominate a Nightingale model. Its size and proportions are substantially different from Sazabi, so it is important to catalog and display the two separately despite their shared pilot and narrative role.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG kit translates the machine’s exceptionally wide shoulders, rear armor, and unusual proportions into a large 1/144 display model.
kits.lore:
The Nightingale is a massive red mobile suit associated with Char Aznable in the Beltorchika’s Children continuity, with a broad frame and remote funnel weapons.

Further background: Nightingale is the heavily armored mobile suit associated with Char Aznable in the Beltorchika’s Children interpretation of the Char’s Counterattack story. Its huge red body, expansive rear binders and funnel armament emphasize overwhelming presence rather than conventional humanoid proportions. The design provides an alternative to the cinematic Sazabi while retaining the thematic connection to Char’s final battle with Amuro.

kits.name: Gundam Lfrith
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Gundam Lfrith is the experimental mobile suit at the center of The Witch from Mercury prologue, developed around the GUND Format and its controversial potential.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG kit represents the original Lfrith rather than the later Aerial or Lfrith Ur variants, with its distinct pink-and-white armor.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Lfrith’s white-and-pink armor, distinctive head, shell-unit detailing and GUND-BIT shield separate it from the later Aerial. Check that the selected kit is the original Lfrith rather than the Lfrith Ur or Thorn variants.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG kit represents the original Lfrith rather than the later Aerial or Lfrith Ur variants, with its distinct pink-and-white armor.
kits.lore:
Gundam Lfrith is the experimental mobile suit at the center of The Witch from Mercury prologue, developed around the GUND Format and its controversial potential.

Further background: Gundam Lfrith is an early experimental GUND-ARM created by Ochs Earth and the Vanadis Institute in The Witch from Mercury’s prologue. Its research program explores the idea that GUND medical technology might enable humanity to live in hostile environments. Its history is tied to Elnora Samaya, her daughter Ericht and the attack that shapes the series’ later conflict.

kits.name: Beguir-Beu
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The Beguir-Beu is an anti-GUND mobile suit featured in The Witch from Mercury prologue. Its technology is designed to counter GUND-based equipment.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG release reproduces the machine’s rounded white-and-purple profile and specialized anti-GUND visual motifs.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Its white-and-purple armor and distinct head shape separate Beguir-Beu from the Gundams it opposes. Notice the weapon layout and aerodynamic-looking forms; compare it with later Grassley designs in the same universe.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG release reproduces the machine’s rounded white-and-purple profile and specialized anti-GUND visual motifs.
kits.lore:
The Beguir-Beu is an anti-GUND mobile suit featured in The Witch from Mercury prologue. Its technology is designed to counter GUND-based equipment.

Further background: Its deployment is linked to the confrontation over the Vanadis Institute and the dangers associated with GUND Format technology. It uses specialized equipment intended to disrupt systems that other Gundams depend on, making its sleek, angular design integral to the series’ early conflict.

kits.name: Guel's Dilanza
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Guel Jeturk’s customized Dilanza is a powerful dueling mobile suit, identifiable by its pink coloring and prominent head crest.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
This HG release focuses on Guel’s custom machine rather than the standard Dilanza or Lauda’s configuration.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Guel’s version features an individualized pink finish and large ornamental elements that distinguish it from standard Dilanza suits. Keep it separate from the later Darilbalde, which represents a different Jeturk design.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: This HG release focuses on Guel’s custom machine rather than the standard Dilanza or Lauda’s configuration.
kits.lore:
Guel Jeturk’s customized Dilanza is a powerful dueling mobile suit, identifiable by its pink coloring and prominent head crest.

Further background: Guel’s Dilanza is a personally customized Jeturk Heavy Machinery mobile suit used during duels at Asticassia School in The Witch from Mercury. Its imposing pink armor and prominent ornamentation show both the company’s design character and Guel Jeturk’s status at the school. The machine is connected to his early rivalry with Suletta Mercury and the series’ system of corporate-sponsored dueling.

kits.name: Chuchu's Demi Trainer
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Chuatury Panlunch uses a personalized Demi Trainer for school duels and later combat. Its oversized rifle makes it a recognizable Earth House machine.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG kit recreates Chuchu’s custom color scheme and weapon-focused stance, separate from the standard Demi Trainer release.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Look for the pink-toned head treatment and the character’s distinctive long-range equipment. It is a customized Demi Trainer, not the basic school training version, so check kit contents before comparing the two.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG kit recreates Chuchu’s custom color scheme and weapon-focused stance, separate from the standard Demi Trainer release.
kits.lore:
Chuatury Panlunch uses a personalized Demi Trainer for school duels and later combat. Its oversized rifle makes it a recognizable Earth House machine.

Further background: Chuchu’s Demi Trainer is a customized training mobile suit used by Chuatury Panlunch at Asticassia in The Witch from Mercury. Its modified head and long-range weaponry distinguish it from the school’s standard Demi Trainer units. The machine reflects Earth House’s determination to compete despite fewer resources than the school’s dominant corporate teams.

kits.name: Darilbalde
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The Darilbalde is a Jeturk-built mobile suit with a red armored body and remotely controlled components used during duels.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG kit highlights the imposing red silhouette, heavy equipment, and the distinctive modular appearance of its armaments.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The red armor and prominent forearm equipment are distinctive. The fictional design uses detachable equipment and multiple combat arrangements; available options differ between kit editions. Confirm the release before assuming that later upgraded Darilbalde parts are included.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG kit highlights the imposing red silhouette, heavy equipment, and the distinctive modular appearance of its armaments.
kits.lore:
The Darilbalde is a Jeturk-built mobile suit with a red armored body and remotely controlled components used during duels.

Further background: Darilbalde is a Jeturk Heavy Machinery dueling mobile suit used by Guel Jeturk in The Witch from Mercury. The machine features a dramatic red silhouette and detachable remote-control equipment that reflects the series’ competitive school environment and the dominance of corporate design teams. Its battles capture Guel’s shifting relationship with his family’s ambitions and his own sense of identity.

kits.name: Gundam Pharact
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The Pharact is a slender GUND-Format machine deployed by Peil Technologies and associated with Elan Ceres. It specializes in high mobility and long-range fighting.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG model features the Pharact’s long limbs, sharp profile, and large rifle, making it distinct from Aerial’s rounded proportions.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Pharact’s slim dark frame, long rifle and equipment around the shoulders and backpack distinguish it from the other school dueling suits. Verify the included accessories when creating a display because the remote weapon effects are not necessarily bundled with every edition.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG model features the Pharact’s long limbs, sharp profile, and large rifle, making it distinct from Aerial’s rounded proportions.
kits.lore:
The Pharact is a slender GUND-Format machine deployed by Peil Technologies and associated with Elan Ceres. It specializes in high mobility and long-range fighting.

Further background: Gundam Pharact is a long-range GUND-ARM developed under Peil Technologies in The Witch from Mercury. It is associated with Elan Ceres and the troubling human experimentation surrounding the GUND Format. In contrast to Aerial’s versatile fighting style, Pharact emphasizes mobility, precision shooting and remote stun-related equipment, giving its dark armor and elongated limbs a purposeful silhouette.

kits.name: Michaelis
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Michaelis is a white-and-purple mobile suit built by Grassley and piloted by Shaddiq Zenelli, with an asymmetric weapons system suited to dueling.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG version recreates the suit’s compact silhouette and distinctive right-arm weapon system.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Michaelis features broad white armor, purple accents and distinctive weapon equipment. It should be treated as its own Grassley design rather than a variation of Beguir-Beu.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG version recreates the suit’s compact silhouette and distinctive right-arm weapon system.
kits.lore:
Michaelis is a white-and-purple mobile suit built by Grassley and piloted by Shaddiq Zenelli, with an asymmetric weapons system suited to dueling.

Further background: Michaelis is a Grassley Defense Systems dueling mobile suit associated with Shaddiq Zenelli in The Witch from Mercury. Its asymmetric-looking combat equipment and refined white-and-purple design represent a different corporate philosophy from Jeturk and Peil machines. Its appearance is tied to the escalation from school competition to the broader political struggle surrounding Asticassia.

kits.name: Gundam Bael
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Gundam Bael is the legendary first Gundam Frame and an emblem of Gjallarhorn authority. McGillis Fareed revives it as a symbol of his ambitions.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG release emphasizes Bael’s white armor, blue details, wing-like rear structures, and paired swords.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Bael has sleek white-and-blue armor, a distinctive backpack and paired swords. The model’s visual focus is the combination of its elegant wing-like details with bare-knuckle sword combat. Do not confuse Bael with Barbatos or other Gundam Frame suits from the same series.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG release emphasizes Bael’s white armor, blue details, wing-like rear structures, and paired swords.
kits.lore:
Gundam Bael is the legendary first Gundam Frame and an emblem of Gjallarhorn authority. McGillis Fareed revives it as a symbol of his ambitions.

Further background: Gundam Bael is one of the legendary Gundam Frames of the Calamity War in Iron-Blooded Orphans. Historically associated with Agnika Kaieru, it acquires enormous symbolic importance within Gjallarhorn because of its ties to the organization’s founding. McGillis Fareed attempts to claim that authority by taking control of Bael, making the machine a symbol of both ambition and contested legitimacy.

kits.name: Gundam Kimaris Vidar
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Gundam Kimaris Vidar is the restored Kimaris form associated with Gaelio Bauduin, combining lance-based fighting with enhanced mobility.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG kit presents the modified Kimaris silhouette and heavy close-combat equipment rather than the earlier Kimaris or Vidar releases.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The spear-like melee silhouette and substantial armor distinguish Kimaris Vidar from Gundam Vidar. The name matters: these are separate configurations, so a kit should be matched to the correct catalog entry before comparing equipment.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG kit presents the modified Kimaris silhouette and heavy close-combat equipment rather than the earlier Kimaris or Vidar releases.
kits.lore:
Gundam Kimaris Vidar is the restored Kimaris form associated with Gaelio Bauduin, combining lance-based fighting with enhanced mobility.

Further background: Kimaris Vidar is an evolved form of the Gundam Kimaris lineage in Iron-Blooded Orphans, connected to Gaelio Bauduin’s role in the conflict with McGillis. Its armor changes substantially from the secretive Gundam Vidar form, incorporating powerful close-combat features and a combat style centered on direct confrontation. The machine’s final battles are deeply personal within Gjallarhorn’s power struggle.

kits.name: Gundam Barbatos Lupus Rex
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Mikazuki Augus pilots this final evolution of Barbatos in Iron-Blooded Orphans. Its elongated arms, claws, and tail weapon emphasize brutal close-range combat.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG version depicts the Lupus Rex form specifically, with an aggressive stance and large forearm proportions different from earlier Barbatos kits.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Lupus Rex is immediately identifiable by its long arms, large hands, tail blade and powerful melee weaponry. These features are the primary visual differences from earlier Barbatos versions. For a display, the dramatic limb proportions matter as much as the weapon, and the exact posing options depend on the kit edition.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG version depicts the Lupus Rex form specifically, with an aggressive stance and large forearm proportions different from earlier Barbatos kits.
kits.lore:
Mikazuki Augus pilots this final evolution of Barbatos in Iron-Blooded Orphans. Its elongated arms, claws, and tail weapon emphasize brutal close-range combat.

Further background: Barbatos Lupus Rex is the final, more feral evolution of the Gundam Frame used by Mikazuki Augus. Its elongated arms, claw-like hands and oversized tail weapon create a predatory silhouette that embodies the escalating cost of Tekkadan’s battles. It is still linked to Mikazuki through the Alaya-Vijnana system, but its appearance and fighting style push the original Barbatos’s physical-combat design to an extreme.

kits.name: Mighty Strike Freedom Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Mighty Strike Freedom combines Strike Freedom’s familiar silhouette with the Proud Defender equipment used during the events of Gundam SEED Freedom.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG release captures this movie-specific configuration, including its prominent backpack and distinctive golden detailing.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Proud Defender arrangement and redesigned wing elements distinguish Mighty Strike Freedom from the older Strike Freedom Gundam. When comparing model kits, check the listed name and scale: a standard Strike Freedom, a Strike Freedom Type II and a Mighty Strike Freedom are distinct products with different equipment.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG release captures this movie-specific configuration, including its prominent backpack and distinctive golden detailing.
kits.lore:
Mighty Strike Freedom combines Strike Freedom’s familiar silhouette with the Proud Defender equipment used during the events of Gundam SEED Freedom.

Further background: The new equipment changes the machine’s silhouette and gives it distinctive capabilities associated with the film’s climactic battles. Piloted by Kira Yamato, it represents both a technical development of the Cosmic Era’s most famous mobile suits and a narrative turning point in the confrontation with Foundation.

kits.name: Rising Freedom Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The Rising Freedom is Kira Yamato’s mobile suit in Gundam SEED Freedom, developed with transformation capability and a familiar blue-and-white visual identity.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG kit represents Rising Freedom rather than the original Freedom, with altered backpack geometry and updated weapon styling.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Rising Freedom design has a distinctive transformable flight silhouette, compact wing elements and contrasting blue-and-white armor. This is not a reissue of Freedom Gundam: pay attention to the new backpack and body lines, as well as the product’s listed equipment and transformation instructions.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG kit represents Rising Freedom rather than the original Freedom, with altered backpack geometry and updated weapon styling.
kits.lore:
The Rising Freedom is Kira Yamato’s mobile suit in Gundam SEED Freedom, developed with transformation capability and a familiar blue-and-white visual identity.

Further background: Rising Freedom Gundam is among the mobile suits operated by COMPASS in Gundam SEED Freedom. Kira Yamato pilots this newer machine during the organization’s peacekeeping operations. It combines a flight-oriented configuration with equipment that continues design ideas from the Strike and Freedom families, reflecting the Cosmic Era’s evolving technologies and the continuing difficulty of maintaining peace after the previous wars.

kits.name: Atlas Gundam (Thunderbolt Ver.)
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The Atlas Gundam is a distinctive amphibious-capable Federation machine piloted by Io Fleming in the Thunderbolt story, with unusual support equipment and long limbs.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG Thunderbolt version reproduces the floating support equipment and striking frame proportions that differentiate Atlas from a standard RX-78.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Atlas’s long sub-legs and curved support structures are signature features. They create a challenging but striking display shape. This specific Thunderbolt design should not be confused with the standard RX-78-2 Gundam.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG Thunderbolt version reproduces the floating support equipment and striking frame proportions that differentiate Atlas from a standard RX-78.
kits.lore:
The Atlas Gundam is a distinctive amphibious-capable Federation machine piloted by Io Fleming in the Thunderbolt story, with unusual support equipment and long limbs.

Further background: Its unusual shape reflects a mobile suit designed for demanding environments and high mobility. Curving sub-legs and substantial exterior equipment make it visually very different from a conventional RX-78-type machine. Its role in Thunderbolt emphasizes the increasingly complex conflict beyond the original battlefront.

kits.name: Shenlong Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Shenlong Gundam is Chang Wufei’s martial-arts-themed machine in Gundam Wing, known for its extendable Dragon Fang and close-combat weapons.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG release presents the TV-series design in a modern 1/144 model with a recognizable arm-mounted Dragon Fang.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The dragon-shaped Dragon Fang arm is the key identifying feature. Shenlong differs from Altron Gundam, which expands the twin-dragon motif. When choosing a model kit, distinguish the television and Endless Waltz design interpretations where relevant.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG release presents the TV-series design in a modern 1/144 model with a recognizable arm-mounted Dragon Fang.
kits.lore:
Shenlong Gundam is Chang Wufei’s martial-arts-themed machine in Gundam Wing, known for its extendable Dragon Fang and close-combat weapons.

Further background: Shenlong Gundam is one of the five Gundams sent to Earth for Operation Meteor in Gundam Wing, piloted by Chang Wufei. Its dragon-shaped arm weapon and martial-arts inspired combat style embody Wufei’s direct and uncompromising approach to battle. Unlike the heavy artillery of Heavyarms or the stealth of Deathscythe, Shenlong favors close-range pressure and specialized melee weapons.

kits.name: Gundam Asmoday
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: Iron-Blooded Orphans G
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Gundam Asmoday is another surviving Gundam Frame associated with the Iron-Blooded Orphans side-story setting, recognizable by its distinctive heavy legs.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The HG model gives builders an unusual Gundam Frame silhouette with prominent knee armor and a rugged IBO aesthetic.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Asmoday has a distinctive angular silhouette and equipment arrangement that should be cataloged under its own name. Avoid applying Barbatos weapon and armor descriptions to this separate Gundam Frame design.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The HG model gives builders an unusual Gundam Frame silhouette with prominent knee armor and a rugged IBO aesthetic.
kits.lore:
Gundam Asmoday is another surviving Gundam Frame associated with the Iron-Blooded Orphans side-story setting, recognizable by its distinctive heavy legs.

Further background: Gundam Asmoday is a Gundam Frame design within the Iron-Blooded Orphans universe and is associated with its extended mobile suit stories and game-related material. Like other machines of its class, its concept traces back to the Calamity War and the unusual persistence of ancient Gundam Frames into later eras. Its outward design differs from the familiar Barbatos, Bael and Kimaris families.

kits.name: RX-78-2 Gundam Ver.2.0
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The original RX-78-2, piloted by Amuro Ray, changed the course of the One Year War and established the Federation’s Gundam legend.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The 2024 Real Grade Ver.2.0 is a distinct model release with revised construction, not the original 2010 RG or the HG kits.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Look for the defining V-fin head, chest vents, contrasting red-and-blue torso and Federation shield. This is the classic RX-78-2 design; the grade and release year distinguish this kit from the many other model interpretations. When comparing editions, pay attention to proportions, surface paneling, joint design and how the core weapons are represented.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: The 2024 Real Grade Ver.2.0 is a distinct model release with revised construction, not the original 2010 RG or the HG kits.
highlights: Iconic Federation shield and beam rifle
Distinct releases vary in surface detail and proportions
kits.lore:
The original RX-78-2, piloted by Amuro Ray, changed the course of the One Year War and established the Federation’s Gundam legend.

Further background: The RX-78-2 is the prototype Earth Federation mobile suit piloted by Amuro Ray during the One Year War. Designed under Project V, it demonstrates how a high-performance mobile suit can change the balance of a conflict dominated by the Principality of Zeon. Its beam rifle, beam sabers and shield became visual signatures of the Gundam line, while Amuro’s growing ability as a pilot gives the machine a central place in Universal Century history.

kits.name: Force Impulse Gundam SpecII
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The Force Impulse Gundam SpecII appears in Gundam SEED Freedom, revisiting the versatile Impulse design in its updated movie configuration.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
This Real Grade is the SpecII edition and should be cataloged separately from the earlier standard Force Impulse RG.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Force silhouette pack and white-blue-red armor are primary identifiers. The Spec II is not identical to the earlier Force Impulse release, so compare version labels and accessory lists carefully.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: This Real Grade is the SpecII edition and should be cataloged separately from the earlier standard Force Impulse RG.
kits.lore:
The Force Impulse Gundam SpecII appears in Gundam SEED Freedom, revisiting the versatile Impulse design in its updated movie configuration.

Further background: Force Impulse Gundam Spec II is an updated Impulse configuration featured in Gundam SEED Freedom, continuing the Cosmic Era’s modular mobile suit concept. Its identity builds on the original Impulse Gundam’s separation and combination systems, while the Force silhouette emphasizes aerial mobility and close-range agility. It is associated with the returning cast and the film’s COMPASS-era conflict.

kits.name: Akatsuki Gundam (Oowashi Unit)
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Akatsuki is Orb’s gold-armored Gundam designed to protect the nation, with a reflective defensive coating and interchangeable equipment.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The RG Oowashi release recreates Akatsuki with its aerial backpack configuration and gleaming gold armor appearance.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The reflective gold finish and broad Oowashi wings dominate this configuration. This is the Oowashi release, not the Shiranui version. The RG edition uses plated parts and specialized equipment; avoid assuming that separately sold accessories are included.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: The RG Oowashi release recreates Akatsuki with its aerial backpack configuration and gleaming gold armor appearance.
kits.lore:
Akatsuki is Orb’s gold-armored Gundam designed to protect the nation, with a reflective defensive coating and interchangeable equipment.

Further background: Akatsuki Gundam is a gold-armored mobile suit associated with Orb in Gundam SEED Destiny. Its Yata-no-Kagami reflective armor and interchangeable equipment make it a conspicuous symbol of Orb’s independence. The Oowashi unit provides an atmospheric flight-oriented backpack and distinguishes this configuration from the Shiranui equipment used in space.

kits.name: ν Gundam (Double Fin Funnel Type)
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Amuro Ray’s Nu Gundam uses psycho-frame technology and Fin Funnels in the final confrontation with Char Aznable. This equipment variant mounts additional funnels.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
This RG release specifically represents the Double Fin Funnel Type, separate from the standard RG Nu Gundam.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Fin Funnel array, white-and-dark-blue armor and bright yellow details distinguish ν Gundam models. Be careful with kit variants: a standard ν Gundam, Double Fin Funnel type, RX-93ff and Hi-ν use related ideas but are not the same release. Confirm which funnel accessories or stands are included with the specific kit.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: This RG release specifically represents the Double Fin Funnel Type, separate from the standard RG Nu Gundam.
kits.lore:
Amuro Ray’s Nu Gundam uses psycho-frame technology and Fin Funnels in the final confrontation with Char Aznable. This equipment variant mounts additional funnels.

Further background: Developed rapidly to confront Char’s Neo Zeon forces, the machine incorporates Psycommu-related technology and the distinctive Fin Funnels, which can provide both attack and protection. Its confrontation with Sazabi is the climactic mobile suit duel of the film and a key event in the Universal Century timeline. The design combines the familiar Federation Gundam face with an asymmetric backpack of remote weapons.

kits.name: MSN-04FF Sazabi
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
MSN-04FF is a special Sazabi interpretation associated with the Gundam SIDE-F installation, featuring an alternate armament arrangement.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The RG model is a distinct commemorative Sazabi release, not the regular 2018 RG Sazabi.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The long double horn funnels are the critical identifiers for this special design and change the balance of the silhouette. The RG MSN-04FF release should not be mistaken for the ordinary RG Sazabi, even though the underlying mobile suit lineage is shared.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: The RG model is a distinct commemorative Sazabi release, not the regular 2018 RG Sazabi.
kits.lore:
MSN-04FF is a special Sazabi interpretation associated with the Gundam SIDE-F installation, featuring an alternate armament arrangement.

Further background: The MSN-04FF Sazabi is a special interpretation of Char Aznable’s Sazabi, closely associated with the life-size Gundam attraction at Gundam Park Fukuoka. Like its original source design, it draws on the intimidating red silhouette of Char’s personal machine from Char’s Counterattack, but this version is especially associated with its distinctive large double horn funnel equipment. It should be cataloged separately from the film’s standard Sazabi.

kits.name: RX-93ff ν Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
RX-93ff is a special Nu Gundam interpretation displayed at Gundam Park Fukuoka, featuring the characteristic Long Range Fin Funnel.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The RG release follows this installation-specific design with its contrasting color accents and signature large funnel weapon.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Fin Funnel array, white-and-dark-blue armor and bright yellow details distinguish ν Gundam models. Be careful with kit variants: a standard ν Gundam, Double Fin Funnel type, RX-93ff and Hi-ν use related ideas but are not the same release. Confirm which funnel accessories or stands are included with the specific kit.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: The RG release follows this installation-specific design with its contrasting color accents and signature large funnel weapon.
kits.lore:
RX-93ff is a special Nu Gundam interpretation displayed at Gundam Park Fukuoka, featuring the characteristic Long Range Fin Funnel.

Further background: Developed rapidly to confront Char’s Neo Zeon forces, the machine incorporates Psycommu-related technology and the distinctive Fin Funnels, which can provide both attack and protection. Its confrontation with Sazabi is the climactic mobile suit duel of the film and a key event in the Universal Century timeline. The design combines the familiar Federation Gundam face with an asymmetric backpack of remote weapons.

kits.name: Gundam Exia Repair II
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Exia Repair II is a rebuilt form of Setsuna F. Seiei’s Gundam Exia appearing near the conclusion of Gundam 00’s second season.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
This RG release represents the repaired form specifically and should not be confused with the standard Exia RG.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
This is specifically the Repair II configuration. Look for the updated limbs, revised outer armor and differences in sword equipment compared with the base Exia. The name is important because ordinary Exia, Exia Repair and Repair II are separate designs.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: This RG release represents the repaired form specifically and should not be confused with the standard Exia RG.
kits.lore:
Exia Repair II is a rebuilt form of Setsuna F. Seiei’s Gundam Exia appearing near the conclusion of Gundam 00’s second season.

Further background: Seiei’s GN-001 from Gundam 00, returning to service after the original machine sustained heavy damage. Its revised appearance represents technological and narrative continuity between Celestial Being’s earlier interventions and the later conflict. The machine retains Exia’s close-combat identity while displaying a cleaner, modified configuration distinct from the heavily damaged Exia Repair.

kits.name: Wing Gundam Zero (TV Version)
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Wing Gundam Zero is the powerful machine connected with the ZERO System in Gundam Wing, eventually piloted by Heero Yuy.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The 2025 RG models the original TV interpretation, distinct from Wing Gundam Zero EW with its feathered wings.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
This is the television design: compare its angular backpack and body proportions with the angel-wing Endless Waltz variant. The different outer geometry matters when selecting a model kit and planning a display.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: The 2025 RG models the original TV interpretation, distinct from Wing Gundam Zero EW with its feathered wings.
kits.lore:
Wing Gundam Zero is the powerful machine connected with the ZERO System in Gundam Wing, eventually piloted by Heero Yuy.

Further background: The television version of Wing Gundam Zero is a powerful machine from Gundam Wing associated with the ZERO System. Its design stands apart from the feather-winged Endless Waltz appearance, using a mechanical wing arrangement and a transformation-oriented silhouette. The Twin Buster Rifle reflects the extreme destructive capability associated with the Zero lineage, while the ZERO System tests a pilot’s ability to confront projected combat outcomes.

kits.name: Zeta Gundam Ver.Ka
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Kamille Bidan’s Zeta Gundam is a transformable mobile suit from the Gryps Conflict, capable of changing into Wave Rider mode.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MG Ver.Ka revisits Zeta’s form and transformation in Katoki’s styling, distinct from older Master Grade Zeta releases.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The elongated shield and wing binders are essential to Zeta’s Waverider configuration. Ver.Ka and other grades interpret the complex transformation differently, so the edition’s actual conversion steps should be checked before handling. The model’s appeal comes from the relationship between mobile suit proportions and its aircraft-like form.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The MG Ver.Ka revisits Zeta’s form and transformation in Katoki’s styling, distinct from older Master Grade Zeta releases.
kits.lore:
Kamille Bidan’s Zeta Gundam is a transformable mobile suit from the Gryps Conflict, capable of changing into Wave Rider mode.

Further background: Developed for the AEUG, it combines a fast-moving Waverider configuration with high-performance mobile suit combat. Its biography is closely tied to Kamille’s growth, the Gryps Conflict and the tensions between the Earth Federation, Titans and anti-Titans forces. The transformation becomes a defining feature of later variable-geometry Gundam designs.

kits.name: Eclipse Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Eclipse Gundam is the lead transformable machine from the SEED Eclipse side story, drawing on Orb and broader Cosmic Era technology.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MG kit emphasizes its sleek armor, aircraft-like transformation, and the distinctive Eclipse silhouette.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Eclipse’s sharp geometry and transformation-related body details distinguish it from the mainline Strike and Freedom families. Its story placement and design should be recorded independently rather than treated as a recolor of an existing Gundam.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The MG kit emphasizes its sleek armor, aircraft-like transformation, and the distinctive Eclipse silhouette.
kits.lore:
Eclipse Gundam is the lead transformable machine from the SEED Eclipse side story, drawing on Orb and broader Cosmic Era technology.

Further background: Eclipse Gundam is the central mobile suit in the Gundam SEED Eclipse side story. Its development reflects the complicated international and technological aftermath of the first Cosmic Era war. The machine is notable for a transformable configuration and designs connected to the mobile suit technologies evolving between Gundam SEED and its successor works.

kits.name: Gundam Virtue
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Tieria Erde pilots the heavily armored Gundam Virtue, which conceals the slimmer Gundam Nadleeh beneath its outer equipment.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Master Grade release highlights Virtue’s bulk and its layered design relationship with Nadleeh.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Virtue models emphasize broad armor masses and heavy beam equipment. The internal Nadleeh reveal is part of the machine’s identity, but support for displaying that form depends on the specific model kit. The MG edition is especially focused on the relationship between the armored Virtue and concealed Nadleeh.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The Master Grade release highlights Virtue’s bulk and its layered design relationship with Nadleeh.
kits.lore:
Tieria Erde pilots the heavily armored Gundam Virtue, which conceals the slimmer Gundam Nadleeh beneath its outer equipment.

Further background: GN-005 Gundam Virtue is the heavy-armor, artillery-oriented member of Celestial Being’s original Gundam team in Gundam 00. Piloted by Tieria Erde, it uses a massive GN Bazooka and GN Cannons, contrasting sharply with Exia’s close-combat specialty. Virtue also conceals Gundam Nadleeh beneath its armor, making the machine’s true configuration part of the team’s strategic capabilities and the mystery surrounding the organization.

kits.name: Wing Gundam Zero EW Ver.Ka
kits.series: New Mobile Report Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Wing Gundam Zero’s Endless Waltz appearance is distinguished by feather-like wings and iconic twin buster rifles used by Heero Yuy.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MG Ver.Ka models the Endless Waltz wing arrangement with intricate posing and backpack presentation; it is not the TV Wing Zero.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The layered wing feathers are the principal display feature of the Endless Waltz design. This form should not be confused with the television Wing Gundam Zero, whose backpack and silhouette are different. At MG or MGSD scale, compare how each release handles the wings’ shape, articulation and support requirements.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The MG Ver.Ka models the Endless Waltz wing arrangement with intricate posing and backpack presentation; it is not the TV Wing Zero.
kits.lore:
Wing Gundam Zero’s Endless Waltz appearance is distinguished by feather-like wings and iconic twin buster rifles used by Heero Yuy.

Further background: Wing Gundam Zero’s Endless Waltz appearance is defined by large, feather-like wings rather than the angular wing arrangement of its television depiction. The machine is connected to Heero Yuy and the conflict following the events of Gundam Wing. Its Twin Buster Rifle embodies the extraordinary destructive potential of the Zero system’s Gundam lineage, while the angelic wing silhouette creates a deliberate contrast with that power.

kits.name: Rick Dom
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The Rick Dom is the space-adapted variant of Zeon’s Dom mobile suit, used in large numbers during the One Year War.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The 2022 MG Rick Dom focuses on the familiar heavy armor and space-use configuration, distinct from the ground-combat Dom.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large skirt armor, bell-shaped legs and imposing torso make Rick Dom visually distinct from slender Zeon suits. The model is a space-use Rick Dom, not simply the terrestrial Dom with a different label.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The 2022 MG Rick Dom focuses on the familiar heavy armor and space-use configuration, distinct from the ground-combat Dom.
kits.lore:
The Rick Dom is the space-adapted variant of Zeon’s Dom mobile suit, used in large numbers during the One Year War.

Further background: In contrast to the ground-operating Dom, its equipment and mobility systems are adapted to space combat, and it serves alongside other mass-produced Zeon units against Federation forces. Its broad purple-and-black silhouette is among the era’s signature designs.

kits.name: Sazabi Ver.Ka
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Char Aznable’s personal Sazabi is a powerful Newtype mobile suit featuring funnels, heavy armor, and striking red colors.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MG Ver.Ka is a highly detailed, large-scale Sazabi with Katoki-inspired layered armor; it is separate from RG Sazabi.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Sazabi’s defining model features are its bulky red armor, funnel equipment, large shoulder structures and extensive rear thruster area. The Ver.Ka and RG interpretations have very different approaches to panel lines and engineering. When identifying a release, distinguish a standard Sazabi from special editions such as the MSN-04FF.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The MG Ver.Ka is a highly detailed, large-scale Sazabi with Katoki-inspired layered armor; it is separate from RG Sazabi.
highlights: Distinct RG, MG and special-edition interpretations
kits.lore:
Char Aznable’s personal Sazabi is a powerful Newtype mobile suit featuring funnels, heavy armor, and striking red colors.

Further background: The massive red machine is designed to exploit the abilities of a Newtype pilot, combining substantial armor and powerful thrusters with funnel remote weapons. Its confrontation with Amuro Ray’s ν Gundam gives the final act of the film much of its emotional weight. Sazabi symbolizes Char’s return to open conflict over humanity’s future on Earth and in space.

kits.name: ν Gundam Ver.Ka
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Amuro Ray’s final personal Gundam combines psycho-frame technology with deployable Fin Funnels to oppose Char’s Sazabi.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MG Ver.Ka interprets Nu Gundam with prominent internal detail and a full Fin Funnel arrangement, distinct from the RG and Entry Grade kits.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Fin Funnel array, white-and-dark-blue armor and bright yellow details distinguish ν Gundam models. Be careful with kit variants: a standard ν Gundam, Double Fin Funnel type, RX-93ff and Hi-ν use related ideas but are not the same release. Confirm which funnel accessories or stands are included with the specific kit.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The MG Ver.Ka interprets Nu Gundam with prominent internal detail and a full Fin Funnel arrangement, distinct from the RG and Entry Grade kits.
kits.lore:
Amuro Ray’s final personal Gundam combines psycho-frame technology with deployable Fin Funnels to oppose Char’s Sazabi.

Further background: Developed rapidly to confront Char’s Neo Zeon forces, the machine incorporates Psycommu-related technology and the distinctive Fin Funnels, which can provide both attack and protection. Its confrontation with Sazabi is the climactic mobile suit duel of the film and a key event in the Universal Century timeline. The design combines the familiar Federation Gundam face with an asymmetric backpack of remote weapons.

kits.name: Hi-ν Gundam Ver.Ka
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack - Beltorchika's Children
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Hi-Nu Gundam is an alternate Nu Gundam interpretation associated with the Beltorchika’s Children continuity and a blue-and-white color scheme.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Master Grade Ver.Ka release features Hi-Nu’s wide funnels and layered design; it is separate from the RG Hi-Nu.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The wing-like Fin Funnel arrays and the blue-and-white coloring provide Hi-ν’s most recognizable look. Its RG and Ver.Ka editions are substantially different products; comparisons should focus on proportions, color separation and the specific edition’s included stand or weapon parts.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The Master Grade Ver.Ka release features Hi-Nu’s wide funnels and layered design; it is separate from the RG Hi-Nu.
kits.lore:
Hi-Nu Gundam is an alternate Nu Gundam interpretation associated with the Beltorchika’s Children continuity and a blue-and-white color scheme.

Further background: Hi-ν Gundam is a reinterpretation of Amuro Ray’s advanced mobile suit associated with the Beltorchika’s Children version of the Char’s Counterattack story. It shares the Newtype-oriented concept of ν Gundam but has a distinctive white-and-blue palette and a more symmetrical array of Fin Funnels. Although related in fiction and design development, Hi-ν is not identical to the film’s RX-93 ν Gundam.

kits.name: Mobile Ginn
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
The GINN is a standard ZAFT mass-production mobile suit in Gundam SEED and a common sight in early Cosmic Era battles.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MG provides a larger, more detailed depiction of a regular ZAFT mobile suit rather than a protagonist Gundam.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Ginn is recognized by its mono-eye head, broad backpack and utilitarian armor. The MG interpretation emphasizes the structure of an ordinary ZAFT machine rather than a unique protagonist Gundam. Keep it separate from specialist Ginn variants.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The MG provides a larger, more detailed depiction of a regular ZAFT mobile suit rather than a protagonist Gundam.
kits.lore:
The GINN is a standard ZAFT mass-production mobile suit in Gundam SEED and a common sight in early Cosmic Era battles.

Further background: It serves as one of the PLANT forces’ defining early-war units and helps establish how mobile suit technology changed the military balance in the Cosmic Era. Although less exotic than the advanced Gundams, Ginn is essential to the setting as a widely deployed machine whose variants reflect different battlefield needs.

kits.name: Gundam Barbatos Lupus
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Barbatos Lupus is a rebuilt form of Mikazuki’s Gundam following its earlier combat damage, with enhanced close-range capability.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The 2025 MG Lupus models the mid-series Barbatos configuration, which is distinct from both MG Barbatos and HG Lupus Rex.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
This edition represents the Lupus redesign, not the original Barbatos or the later Lupus Rex. Focus on the larger shoulders, revised limbs, angular head and signature sword-mace profile. The kit’s grade determines the level of mechanical detailing; check the release-specific contents before assuming extra weapons or optional forms are included.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The 2025 MG Lupus models the mid-series Barbatos configuration, which is distinct from both MG Barbatos and HG Lupus Rex.
highlights: Distinct from Barbatos and Lupus Rex
kits.lore:
Barbatos Lupus is a rebuilt form of Mikazuki’s Gundam following its earlier combat damage, with enhanced close-range capability.

Further background: Barbatos Lupus is a rebuilt form of Mikazuki Augus’s Gundam Frame used as Tekkadan’s conflicts intensify. Its redesigned armor and altered proportions emphasize acceleration and physical aggression, making it visually distinct from earlier Barbatos forms. It retains the defining connection between Mikazuki, the Alaya-Vijnana interface and Tekkadan’s rise through the post-Calamity War political landscape.

kits.name: Providence Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Rau Le Creuset pilots Providence Gundam, a heavily armed ZAFT machine carrying a DRAGOON remote weapon system.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MG kit focuses on Providence’s huge rear DRAGOON equipment and aggressive end-of-series appearance.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large DRAGOON units around the backpack and rear silhouette are the defining display features. Providence should not be confused with Legend Gundam or Strike Freedom, which also use remote armaments but have different shapes and equipment.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The MG kit focuses on Providence’s huge rear DRAGOON equipment and aggressive end-of-series appearance.
kits.lore:
Rau Le Creuset pilots Providence Gundam, a heavily armed ZAFT machine carrying a DRAGOON remote weapon system.

Further background: Providence Gundam is Rau Le Creuset’s heavily armed mobile suit in Gundam SEED. It uses an extensive DRAGOON remote weapon system, allowing multi-directional attacks that challenge the protagonists during the final phase of the war. Its stark head design and radiating backpack distinguish it from ZAFT’s other advanced Gundams, while Rau’s role as its pilot makes it closely linked to the story’s debate over human destiny and resentment.

kits.name: Gundam Aerial
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Suletta Mercury’s Gundam Aerial is a GUND-Format machine built around a shield system comprising remote GUND-BIT components.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MGSD Aerial reinterprets the original Aerial design in Master Grade-inspired SD proportions; it is separate from the HG and Full Mechanics kits.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Aerial’s design contrasts relatively smooth white armor with translucent-looking shell-unit details and multiple GUND-BIT components. Check the release name carefully: the original Aerial and Aerial Rebuild have different silhouettes and equipment. The standard HG, Full Mechanics and MGSD releases offer distinct interpretations of the same core machine.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
MGSD combines super-deformed proportions with relatively ambitious detail and engineering. It is not assigned a conventional numerical scale.
kits.summary: The MGSD Aerial reinterprets the original Aerial design in Master Grade-inspired SD proportions; it is separate from the HG and Full Mechanics kits.
kits.lore:
Suletta Mercury’s Gundam Aerial is a GUND-Format machine built around a shield system comprising remote GUND-BIT components.

Further background: Gundam Aerial is piloted by Suletta Mercury at Asticassia School of Technology in The Witch from Mercury. It is associated with the GUND Format and uses detachable GUND-BIT units that can act as remote weapons or combine into a defensive shield. Aerial’s seemingly unusual responsiveness is a central mystery of the series.
