kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Banagher Links pilots the Unicorn Gundam, which features an NT-D transformation from restrained Unicorn Mode into Destroy Mode.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The MGEX release is a premium Unicorn model with an illuminated psycho-frame emphasis and Ver.Ka detailing; it is distinct from regular MG Unicorn kits.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Unicorn model kits are distinguished by their transformation between restrained white armor and an expanded Destroy Mode silhouette. How that transformation is realized varies significantly with grade. Do not confuse Unicorn with Banshee, Phenex or the later Full Armor configurations.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
MGEX is an advanced 1/100 Master Grade line built around a showcase engineering or visual theme. The specific theme depends on the named release.
kits.summary: The MGEX release is a premium Unicorn model with an illuminated psycho-frame emphasis and Ver.Ka detailing; it is distinct from regular MG Unicorn kits.
kits.lore:
Banagher Links pilots the Unicorn Gundam, which features an NT-D transformation from restrained Unicorn Mode into Destroy Mode.

Further background: RX-0 Unicorn Gundam is a prototype mobile suit central to the events of Gundam Unicorn. Banagher Links becomes its pilot, and its hidden capabilities are tied to the Laplace’s Box conflict and the possibility of a different future for the Universal Century. Unicorn’s transformation from a white Unicorn Mode into the exposed psycho-frame Destroy Mode makes its appearance a metaphor for the latent power and dangers of Newtype technology.

kits.name: Gundam Aerial
kits.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Suletta Mercury’s original Aerial fights using GUND-BIT components that can form a shield or operate independently in battle.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The 1/100 Full Mechanics Aerial brings the rounded proportions of the original design to a larger scale, distinct from the HG and MGSD releases.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Aerial’s design contrasts relatively smooth white armor with translucent-looking shell-unit details and multiple GUND-BIT components. Check the release name carefully: the original Aerial and Aerial Rebuild have different silhouettes and equipment. The standard HG, Full Mechanics and MGSD releases offer distinct interpretations of the same core machine.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Full Mechanics is a 1/100 line emphasizing expressive external detail and accessible construction without being identical to MG engineering.
kits.summary: The 1/100 Full Mechanics Aerial brings the rounded proportions of the original design to a larger scale, distinct from the HG and MGSD releases.
kits.lore:
Suletta Mercury’s original Aerial fights using GUND-BIT components that can form a shield or operate independently in battle.

Further background: Gundam Aerial is piloted by Suletta Mercury at Asticassia School of Technology in The Witch from Mercury. It is associated with the GUND Format and uses detachable GUND-BIT units that can act as remote weapons or combine into a defensive shield. Aerial’s seemingly unusual responsiveness is a central mystery of the series.

kits.name: Calamity Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Calamity Gundam is an Earth Alliance artillery-focused mobile suit piloted by Orga Sabnak during the later Gundam SEED battles.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Full Mechanics kit depicts its bulky ranged-combat configuration and dual shoulder-mounted cannons in 1/100 scale.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large shoulder-mounted and handheld ranged weapons are central to Calamity’s look. In Full Mechanics scale, the emphasis remains on the heavy-artillery design rather than transformable or close-combat gimmicks.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Full Mechanics is a 1/100 line emphasizing expressive external detail and accessible construction without being identical to MG engineering.
kits.summary: The Full Mechanics kit depicts its bulky ranged-combat configuration and dual shoulder-mounted cannons in 1/100 scale.
kits.lore:
Calamity Gundam is an Earth Alliance artillery-focused mobile suit piloted by Orga Sabnak during the later Gundam SEED battles.

Further background: It is associated with the Biological CPU pilot Orga Sabnak and specializes in heavy artillery support. Its oversized ranged weapons create a broad silhouette distinct from the fast-moving Raider and defensive Forbidden, the two other mobile suits frequently fielded alongside it.

kits.name: Raider Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Raider Gundam is a transformable Earth Alliance mobile suit piloted by Clotho Buer, capable of changing to a mobile armor form.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Full Mechanics kit captures its distinctive black-and-red coloring and flight-oriented transformation silhouette.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Its black-and-red armor, transformation-oriented shapes and distinctive weaponry set Raider apart from Calamity’s artillery role. Confirm the specific conversion steps and included parts in the edition’s instructions.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Full Mechanics is a 1/100 line emphasizing expressive external detail and accessible construction without being identical to MG engineering.
kits.summary: The Full Mechanics kit captures its distinctive black-and-red coloring and flight-oriented transformation silhouette.
kits.lore:
Raider Gundam is a transformable Earth Alliance mobile suit piloted by Clotho Buer, capable of changing to a mobile armor form.

Further background: Raider Gundam is an Earth Alliance mobile suit in Gundam SEED that can transform into a flight-oriented mobile armor configuration. Piloted by Clotho Buer, it operates alongside Calamity and Forbidden as part of the Alliance’s trio of advanced units. Its black-and-red coloring and unusual weapons reflect a design philosophy centered on attack speed and close-range pressure.

kits.name: Forbidden Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Forbidden Gundam is an Earth Alliance mobile suit piloted by Shani Andras, known for its unique backpack and energy-deflecting systems.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Full Mechanics kit highlights its large backpack profile and unusual weapon arrangement in 1/100 scale.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large scythe, broad rear equipment and curved armor define the Forbidden look. Unlike Raider, its identity centers on defensive systems and unusual beam interactions rather than a flight transformation.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Full Mechanics is a 1/100 line emphasizing expressive external detail and accessible construction without being identical to MG engineering.
kits.summary: The Full Mechanics kit highlights its large backpack profile and unusual weapon arrangement in 1/100 scale.
kits.lore:
Forbidden Gundam is an Earth Alliance mobile suit piloted by Shani Andras, known for its unique backpack and energy-deflecting systems.

Further background: Forbidden Gundam is one of three Earth Alliance advanced units introduced in Gundam SEED. Piloted by Shani Andras, it combines a distinctive heavy, curved combat form with defensive technology designed to distort incoming beam attacks. Its large scythe and dark coloration distinguish it from the Calamity and Raider units used by the same group.

kits.name: RX-78-2 Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Amuro Ray’s RX-78-2 is the original Federation Gundam and an icon of the One Year War.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Entry Grade version is designed as an approachable, tool-light introduction to Gunpla, distinct from HG, RG, and PG versions.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Look for the defining V-fin head, chest vents, contrasting red-and-blue torso and Federation shield. This is the classic RX-78-2 design; the grade and release year distinguish this kit from the many other model interpretations. When comparing editions, pay attention to proportions, surface paneling, joint design and how the core weapons are represented.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Entry Grade focuses on a streamlined, approachable assembly experience. Compare detail and part breakdown with higher grades of the same subject.
kits.summary: The Entry Grade version is designed as an approachable, tool-light introduction to Gunpla, distinct from HG, RG, and PG versions.
highlights: Iconic Federation shield and beam rifle
Distinct releases vary in surface detail and proportions
kits.lore:
Amuro Ray’s RX-78-2 is the original Federation Gundam and an icon of the One Year War.

Further background: The RX-78-2 is the prototype Earth Federation mobile suit piloted by Amuro Ray during the One Year War. Designed under Project V, it demonstrates how a high-performance mobile suit can change the balance of a conflict dominated by the Principality of Zeon. Its beam rifle, beam sabers and shield became visual signatures of the Gundam line, while Amuro’s growing ability as a pilot gives the machine a central place in Universal Century history.

kits.name: Strike Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Strike Gundam is Kira Yamato’s early mobile suit in Gundam SEED, designed to use different Striker Packs for varying missions.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Entry Grade Strike focuses on easy assembly of the recognizable base Strike design; accessories and pack configurations differ between products.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The core Strike body has a white-blue-red color scheme and a distinctive attachment system for Striker equipment. The standard Strike, Perfect Strike and other package-specific releases must be identified separately; not every product includes all Striker packs.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Entry Grade focuses on a streamlined, approachable assembly experience. Compare detail and part breakdown with higher grades of the same subject.
kits.summary: The Entry Grade Strike focuses on easy assembly of the recognizable base Strike design; accessories and pack configurations differ between products.
kits.lore:
Strike Gundam is Kira Yamato’s early mobile suit in Gundam SEED, designed to use different Striker Packs for varying missions.

Further background: Strike Gundam is the GAT-X105 Earth Alliance prototype that Kira Yamato pilots early in Gundam SEED. Its Striker Pack compatibility allows it to be equipped for different combat roles, including the Aile, Sword and Launcher configurations. The machine’s versatility and conflict with ZAFT’s stolen Gundams place it at the center of the early Cosmic Era narrative.

kits.name: ν Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Amuro Ray’s Nu Gundam uses psycho-frame technology and Fin Funnels during the events of Char’s Counterattack.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Entry Grade Nu is an accessible version of the Nu Gundam design. It should not be confused with RG or MG releases, and equipment varies by product.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Fin Funnel array, white-and-dark-blue armor and bright yellow details distinguish ν Gundam models. Be careful with kit variants: a standard ν Gundam, Double Fin Funnel type, RX-93ff and Hi-ν use related ideas but are not the same release. Confirm which funnel accessories or stands are included with the specific kit.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Entry Grade focuses on a streamlined, approachable assembly experience. Compare detail and part breakdown with higher grades of the same subject.
kits.summary: The Entry Grade Nu is an accessible version of the Nu Gundam design.
kits.lore:
Amuro Ray’s Nu Gundam uses psycho-frame technology and Fin Funnels during the events of Char’s Counterattack.

Further background: Developed rapidly to confront Char’s Neo Zeon forces, the machine incorporates Psycommu-related technology and the distinctive Fin Funnels, which can provide both attack and protection. Its confrontation with Sazabi is the climactic mobile suit duel of the film and a key event in the Universal Century timeline. The design combines the familiar Federation Gundam face with an asymmetric backpack of remote weapons.

kits.name: Wing Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Heero Yuy pilots Wing Gundam, a transformable Operation Meteor machine armed with the buster rifle in Gundam Wing.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
This 2025 Entry Grade release provides a simplified build of the TV Wing Gundam design.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The Bird Mode silhouette and Buster Rifle are the most recognizable features of this original Wing Gundam. It should not be confused with Wing Gundam Zero, whose weaponry, systems and body configuration are significantly different.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Entry Grade focuses on a streamlined, approachable assembly experience. Compare detail and part breakdown with higher grades of the same subject.
kits.summary: This 2025 Entry Grade release provides a simplified build of the TV Wing Gundam design.
kits.lore:
Heero Yuy pilots Wing Gundam, a transformable Operation Meteor machine armed with the buster rifle in Gundam Wing.

Further background: Built for Operation Meteor, it combines a humanoid combat mode with a Bird Mode designed for high-speed atmospheric movement. The machine’s large Buster Rifle and green chest sensor become hallmarks of the series, while its role in the early struggle between the colonies, OZ and the Earth Sphere Alliance sets up the conflicts that follow.

kits.name: Perfect Strike Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Perfect Strike Gundam combines the Aile, Sword, and Launcher Striker equipment into a heavily outfitted version of the Strike Gundam.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Perfect Grade kit presents the full multi-pack loadout at 1/60 scale with a large, equipment-heavy silhouette.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large combined Striker pack, heavy sword and long-range cannon are essential identifiers. A Perfect Strike product is not the same as an ordinary Strike Gundam kit, which may omit some or all of the additional equipment.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Perfect Grade uses a large 1/60 presentation with intricate assembly and display presence. Details depend on the edition.
kits.summary: The Perfect Grade kit presents the full multi-pack loadout at 1/60 scale with a large, equipment-heavy silhouette.
highlights: Combined Aile, Sword and Launcher equipment
kits.lore:
Perfect Strike Gundam combines the Aile, Sword, and Launcher Striker equipment into a heavily outfitted version of the Strike Gundam.

Further background: Perfect Strike Gundam is a configuration of the GAT-X105 Strike Gundam associated with the combination of the Aile, Sword and Launcher Striker systems in Gundam SEED. The Strike was originally intended to adapt to different missions by exchanging its equipment; the Perfect Strike combines their functions into a heavily armed form. Its silhouette is crowded with equipment compared with the standard Strike Gundam.

kits.name: 00 Gundam Seven Sword/G
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
00 Gundam Seven Sword/G is a weapon-focused variation of Setsuna’s 00 Gundam with multiple blades and a GN Sword II Blaster.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The PG release emphasizes its expansive sword equipment and oversized 1/60 presentation.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The diverse sword loadout is the main reason to select this version. Verify the release’s listed weapon parts and mounting arrangements, rather than treating it as a standard 00 Gundam. The large blade equipment strongly shapes how the model balances on display.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Perfect Grade uses a large 1/60 presentation with intricate assembly and display presence. Details depend on the edition.
kits.summary: The PG release emphasizes its expansive sword equipment and oversized 1/60 presentation.
kits.lore:
00 Gundam Seven Sword/G is a weapon-focused variation of Setsuna’s 00 Gundam with multiple blades and a GN Sword II Blaster.

Further background: Seiei’s twin-drive 00 Gundam from the Gundam 00 universe. Its design emphasizes multiple swords and bladed equipment, extending the close-combat heritage established by Exia. The equipment distinguishes this configuration from both the standard 00 Gundam and the 00 Raiser; the exact set of weapons matters when cataloging the kit.

kits.name: Gundam Exia
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Setsuna F. Seiei pilots the close-combat Gundam Exia, an early Celestial Being machine equipped with multiple GN-powered blades.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Perfect Grade Exia uses a large frame and detailed mechanical structure to recreate the GN Drive-era design.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Exia is identified by its angular white armor, green GN condenser elements and asymmetrical GN Sword. Its blade-focused equipment separates it from Dynames, Kyrios and Virtue. Exia, Exia Repair and Exia Repair II should be treated as distinct editions when choosing model details and accessories.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Perfect Grade uses a large 1/60 presentation with intricate assembly and display presence. Details depend on the edition.
kits.summary: The Perfect Grade Exia uses a large frame and detailed mechanical structure to recreate the GN Drive-era design.
highlights: GN Sword and Seven Swords concept
kits.lore:
Setsuna F. Seiei pilots the close-combat Gundam Exia, an early Celestial Being machine equipped with multiple GN-powered blades.

Further background: The GN-001 Gundam Exia is one of Celestial Being’s original Gundams in Gundam 00, piloted by Setsuna F. Powered by a GN Drive, it specializes in close combat and carries multiple blades, leading to its Seven Swords design concept. Exia is central to Celestial Being’s armed interventions and to Setsuna’s personal understanding of what a Gundam represents.

kits.name: Unicorn Gundam 02 Banshee Norn
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Banshee Norn is a black-and-gold Unicorn-series machine with a powerful NT-D mode and equipment distinct from Banagher’s white Unicorn.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Perfect Grade release recreates Banshee Norn’s armor and transformation at 1/60 scale, separate from the PG Unicorn.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The dark armor, gold psycho-frame appearance and Armed Armor equipment provide the key visual cues. For this release, distinguish Banshee Norn from standard Banshee and the white Unicorn: their backpack and armament arrangements vary.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Perfect Grade uses a large 1/60 presentation with intricate assembly and display presence. Details depend on the edition.

kits.lore:
Banshee Norn is a black-and-gold Unicorn-series machine with a powerful NT-D mode and equipment distinct from Banagher’s white Unicorn.

Further background: Banshee Norn is a reconfigured form of the second RX-0 Unicorn Gundam, associated with Riddhe Marcenas in Gundam Unicorn. Its black-and-gold armor sharply contrasts with Banagher’s white Unicorn, while its advanced equipment and psycho-frame technology make it central to the closing struggle over Laplace’s Box. Banshee Norn is a distinct configuration from the earlier Banshee and from Unicorn Gundam.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT

kits.name: Strike Freedom Gundam
kits.notes:
MOBILE SUIT BACKGROUND
Kira Yamato’s Strike Freedom Gundam is a high-mobility Cosmic Era machine equipped with DRAGOON remote weapons and a distinctive winged backpack.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Perfect Grade release emphasizes the enormous wing span and elaborate weapons at 1/60 scale, unlike the MGEX or smaller-scale variants.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The gold frame and large DRAGOON-equipped wings are essential visual details. Model-kit editions vary substantially: MGEX focuses on its multi-layered gold-frame presentation, whereas PG and other grades differ in size and construction. Judge details and display capabilities by the specific release rather than assuming accessories carry across editions.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Perfect Grade uses a large 1/60 presentation with intricate assembly and display presence. Details depend on the edition.
kits.summary: The Perfect Grade release emphasizes the enormous wing span and elaborate weapons at 1/60 scale, unlike the MGEX or smaller-scale variants.
kits.lore:
Kira Yamato’s Strike Freedom Gundam is a high-mobility Cosmic Era machine equipped with DRAGOON remote weapons and a distinctive winged backpack.

Further background: Strike Freedom Gundam is Kira Yamato’s advanced machine in Gundam SEED Destiny, designed for tremendous mobility and simultaneous attacks against multiple opponents. Its wing assemblies carry DRAGOON remote weapons, while its gold-colored frame and high-output beam armaments create an unmistakable appearance. The suit is closely associated with Kira’s effort to intervene in the renewed Cosmic Era conflict without simply becoming another instrument of the escalating war.

The Demi Barding combines a utilitarian trainer-inspired frame with more substantial shoulder and backpack equipment. Its yellow, white and dark accents emphasize a practical support-unit style. It should be listed separately from ChuChu’s Demi Trainer and the standard Demi Trainer.
kits.summary: An upgraded Earth House mobile suit related to the Demi Trainer line.
kits.lore: The MSJ-R122 Demi Barding is a support-oriented mobile suit seen in The Witch from Mercury and associated with Earth House. It is connected to Chuatury Panlunch’s later role in the series and represents an evolution beyond the school’s basic Demi Trainer platform. Its additional backpack equipment helps distinguish it from ordinary student-use units.

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Lfrith Ur has a broad upper body, dark heavy-looking armor and a blocky silhouette markedly different from Aerial. Its compactness and bulky arm structures are the distinctive visual features. It should not be confused with Lfrith Thorn or the original Lfrith prototype.
kits.summary: Sophie Pulone’s GUND-ARM from The Witch from Mercury.
kits.lore: Gundam Lfrith Ur is one of the Gundam-type mobile suits operated by the Earth-based Dawn of Fold in The Witch from Mercury. Sophie Pulone pilots the machine, whose use of GUND Format technology puts its operator at significant risk. Its story connects the Asticassia duels to the broader political violence beyond the school.
highlights: Sophie Pulone and Dawn of Fold

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Lfrith Thorn has a strikingly compact torso and unusually long arms, lending its design a forward-leaning silhouette. The machine is not a recolor of Lfrith Ur; the two have different body layouts. Edition-specific parts and weapons should be verified from the selected kit.
kits.summary: Norea Du Noc’s distinctive long-armed GUND-ARM.
kits.lore: Gundam Lfrith Thorn is the companion Gundam-type machine to Lfrith Ur in The Witch from Mercury, piloted by Norea Du Noc. Like Ur, it places GUND Format risk at the center of its combat power and connects the school narrative with the Earthian conflict. Its unconventional body proportions make it immediately recognizable beside other Gundams.

kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Blitz has dark armor, angular limbs and a large multifunction shield-mounted weapon system. The aggressive black-purple silhouette contrasts sharply with the brighter Duel and Aegis. Any included effect parts and the execution of its stealth-oriented equipment depend on the specific release.
kits.summary: Nicol Amalfi’s stealth-focused GAT-X machine from Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: The GAT-X207 Blitz Gundam is a stolen Earth Alliance prototype piloted by Nicol Amalfi in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED. Its Mirage Colloid technology allows stealthy approaches that conventional mobile suits cannot easily counter. Nicol’s deployment of the Blitz becomes important in the escalating conflict between the Archangel crew and ZAFT pursuit forces.

kits.name: FREEDOM GUNDAM
aliases: HG 1/144 フリーダムガンダム
機動戦士ガンダム SEED
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The wings and layered backpack give Freedom a broad outline even at smaller scales. Its distinctive equipment includes shoulder cannons, railguns and beam armaments. Differing grades and later redesigns can have different proportions and engineering; do not confuse the original Freedom with Strike Freedom, Rising Freedom or Mighty Strike Freedom.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Kira Yamato’s winged, multi-target combat Gundam from Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: Freedom Gundam is a ZAFT-built high-performance mobile suit that becomes Kira Yamato’s principal machine during the later stages of Gundam SEED. Powered by a nuclear reactor, it combines extreme mobility with powerful multi-target ranged attacks. The spread of its wings, shoulder-mounted cannons and railguns makes it one of the series’ most recognizable silhouettes. Its presence changes the balance of the Earth Alliance–PLANT conflict and reflects Kira’s growing opposition to a war driven by cycles of retaliation.

kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Astray Red Frame models feature distinctive exposed red frame sections, white armor and sword-oriented posing. They vary considerably between normal, Kai and other equipment configurations. Check the precise edition before assuming a particular katana, backpack or effect part is included.
kits.summary: Lowe Guele’s salvager Gundam with striking red framework and sword imagery.
kits.lore: The MBF-P02 Gundam Astray Red Frame is a prototype from Gundam SEED Astray, the side-story setting around the main Cosmic Era conflict. Lowe Guele of the Junk Guild becomes its signature pilot and uses ingenuity and salvaged equipment to survive much larger battles. The Red Frame is especially associated with a Japanese-style sword, giving it a different fighting identity from ordinary rifle-equipped Gundams.
highlights: Lowe Guele and the Junk Guild

kits.name: GUNDAM ASTRAY (BLUE FRAME)
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムアストレイ ブルーフレーム

kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Blue Frame retains the Astray family’s angular armor and visible frame styling but uses blue accents and a more military identity. Second L, D and other named upgrades differ dramatically in equipment and should not automatically inherit this base-profile entry. Compare the complete title when identifying the exact release.
kits.summary: Gai Murakumo’s mercenary-operated Astray prototype.
kits.lore: The MBF-P03 Gundam Astray Blue Frame belongs to the same Orb prototype family as the Red Frame but follows a different path in Gundam SEED Astray. It is strongly associated with mercenary pilot Gai Murakumo and his Serpent Tail group. Combat modifications emphasize professional battlefield practicality and mission-specific armament.

kits.lore: Sinanju Stein represents the development lineage behind the red Sinanju. The Narrative version appears in Gundam Narrative in connection with Zoltan Akkanen and the Neo Zeon remnant forces. Its paler, straighter-edged armor makes it visibly different from Full Frontal’s highly ornamented red machine. Version labels matter, because Unicorn and Narrative interpretations are not necessarily the same depicted configuration.

kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Infinite Justice is recognizable by its vivid pink-red armor and the Fatum-01 lifter. Leg-mounted beam weapon themes give it a different silhouette and combat presentation from the earlier Justice. Do not mix it with the Infinite Justice Type II, whose updated design belongs to a later story.
kits.summary: Athrun’s upgraded Justice Gundam from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X19A Infinite Justice Gundam is Athrun Zala’s advanced successor to the original Justice in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. It maintains the mobile suit’s characteristic high-mobility flight equipment while bringing a stronger close-combat emphasis to the final conflict. It forms a memorable pairing with Kira’s Strike Freedom in the story’s late battles.

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Legend’s dark gray and blue accents, broad backpack and remote-weapon silhouette set it apart from standard frontline Gundams. Its DRAGOON equipment is key to the design, though the way deployed weapons can be displayed differs among releases. Avoid confusing it with Providence despite their shared remote-weapon concepts.
kits.summary: Rey Za Burrel’s DRAGOON-equipped Gundam in SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X666S Legend Gundam appears in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny and is piloted by Rey Za Burrel. It employs a DRAGOON remote-weapon system, reflecting Cosmic Era interest in all-range combat. Legend’s appearance contributes to the conflicts surrounding the Destiny Plan and ZAFT’s final military operations.

aliases: HG 1/144 デスティニーガンダム
機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Destiny’s striking V-fin, red wing elements and large sword silhouette make it suited to dynamic posing. Expanded wings and combat-effect imagery are important to its identity, but availability differs between normal and special-edition kits. Distinguish Destiny from the later Destiny Spec II interpretation.
kits.summary: Shinn Asuka’s multi-role Gundam from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X42S Destiny Gundam appears in Gundam SEED Destiny as the signature advanced machine of Shinn Asuka. It combines multiple combat roles in one platform: close-combat equipment, ranged weapons and high-speed maneuvering systems. Its deployment reflects the rising stakes and shifting loyalties of the later Cosmic Era war.

kits.name: GUNDAM EXIA
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムエクシア
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Exia is identified by its angular white armor, green GN condenser elements and asymmetrical GN Sword. Its blade-focused equipment separates it from Dynames, Kyrios and Virtue. Exia, Exia Repair and Exia Repair II should be treated as distinct editions when choosing model details and accessories.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Setsuna’s original Seven Swords mobile suit from Gundam 00.
kits.lore: The GN-001 Gundam Exia is one of Celestial Being’s original Gundams in Gundam 00, piloted by Setsuna F. Seiei. Powered by a GN Drive, it specializes in close combat and carries multiple blades, leading to its Seven Swords design concept. Exia is central to Celestial Being’s armed interventions and to Setsuna’s personal understanding of what a Gundam represents. It later undergoes major repairs and modifications following the first season’s battles.
highlights: GN Sword and Seven Swords concept

kits.name: GUNDAM DYNAMES
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムデュナメス
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Dynames models emphasize a long rifle, shoulder-mounted shields and a comparatively slim chest. A GN-Arms combination is a separate package and should not be treated as the standard Dynames kit. Trans-Am and clear-color releases retain the same broad machine identity but differ in presentation and product specifics.
kits.summary: Celestial Being’s specialist long-range Gundam piloted by Lockon Stratos.
kits.lore: The GN-002 Gundam Dynames is Celestial Being’s specialized long-range Gundam in the first season of Gundam 00. Lockon Stratos pilots it as one of the original Gundam Meisters, concentrating on precision shooting while teammates cover other combat roles. Its GN Sniper Rifle and head targeting arrangement support its specialist identity; Haro assists during demanding combat situations.

kits.name: GUNDAM KYRIOS
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムキュリオス
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Kyrios design combines an orange-and-white color scheme with a pointed, aircraft-influenced silhouette. Its transformation is the most obvious design difference from Exia and Dynames. Whether a model performs a full conversion or uses alternative parts depends on the specific grade and release.
kits.summary: Celestial Being’s transformable Gundam piloted by Allelujah Haptism.
kits.lore: The GN-003 Gundam Kyrios is a transformable Gundam operated by Celestial Being in Gundam 00. Allelujah Haptism pilots it and makes use of its aircraft-like form for high-speed operations. Kyrios complements the first-generation Gundam team by giving it mobility and transformation options alongside the other units’ specialist roles.

aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムヴァーチェ
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Virtue models emphasize broad armor masses and heavy beam equipment. The internal Nadleeh reveal is part of the machine’s identity, but support for displaying that form depends on the specific model kit. The MG edition is especially focused on the relationship between the armored Virtue and concealed Nadleeh.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Tieria’s heavily armored Celestial Being Gundam from Gundam 00.
kits.lore: GN-005 Gundam Virtue is the heavy-armor, artillery-oriented member of Celestial Being’s original Gundam team in Gundam 00. Piloted by Tieria Erde, it uses a massive GN Bazooka and GN Cannons, contrasting sharply with Exia’s close-combat specialty. Virtue also conceals Gundam Nadleeh beneath its armor, making the machine’s true configuration part of the team’s strategic capabilities and the mystery surrounding the organization.

kits.name: GYAN
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Gyan models center on a narrow helmet-like head, a fencing-style beam saber and an unusual rounded shield design. The relatively slim torso and broad leg armor give it a unique silhouette. Do not confuse the original Gyan with Gyan Strom or Build-series reinterpretations.
kits.summary: M’Quve’s close-combat Zeon prototype from the original Gundam.
kits.lore: The YMS-15 Gyan is an experimental Zeon mobile suit associated with M’Quve in the original Mobile Suit Gundam. Unlike the more balanced Gelgoog, its striking design emphasizes close-quarters combat. M’Quve’s use of the machine gives its appearances a distinctive duelist character rather than the mass-production military role of a regular Zaku.

kits.name: QUBELEY
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Look for the sweeping shoulder binders, compact central torso, funnel containers and smooth organic armor shapes. Depending on the exact kit, posing the binders and representing deployed funnels can be central to the display. Qubeley Mk-II, mass-production Qubeley and Build-series redesigns deserve separate references.
kits.summary: Haman Karn’s funnel-equipped Newtype mobile suit from Zeta Gundam and Gundam ZZ.
kits.lore: The AMX-004 Qubeley is a Newtype-use machine associated with Haman Karn and the Axis forces in Zeta Gundam and Gundam ZZ. Its remote-controlled funnels, curved armor and broad shoulder binders create a silhouette unlike the Federation’s conventional mobile suits. Haman’s ability to employ the Psycommu-controlled weapons makes the Qubeley a formidable opponent. Later Qubeley Mk-II units use related technology but belong to different pilots and must not be mistaken for the original.

kits.name: HYAKU-SHIKI
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
A Hyaku-Shiki model is defined by its gold surfaces, distinctive narrow head and rear binders. Metallic coatings, painted gold and ordinary molded finishes can look very different, even when the underlying machine is the same. Keep the standard Hyaku-Shiki separate from Hyaku-Shiki Kai and custom Build-series variants when comparing products.
kits.summary: The AEUG’s gold mobile suit piloted by Quattro Bajeena.
kits.lore: The golden MSN-00100 Hyaku-Shiki is a prototype mobile suit used by the AEUG during the Gryps Conflict. Quattro Bajeena, Char Aznable operating under an assumed identity, becomes its best-known pilot. Its development is connected to the Delta Gundam design line, and it favors mobility and skilled piloting over a conventional Gundam face. The machine is particularly memorable for its gold armor and its appearances alongside the Zeta Gundam and Gundam Mk-II.

kits.name: QUBELEY Mk-Ⅱ
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Mk-II retains the striking shoulder binders and curved armored form of the original Qubeley. Color and edition information are vital: Elpeo Ple and Ple Two versions should be treated as distinct kit releases where appropriate. Do not apply the white original Qubeley’s artwork or markings to a Mk-II by default.
kits.summary: A successor Qubeley used by different Newtype pilots in Gundam ZZ.
kits.lore: Qubeley Mk-II machines are derived from the original Qubeley and appear in Gundam ZZ under different Newtype pilots, including Elpeo Ple and Ple Two. Although related to Haman Karn’s original mobile suit, each machine has its own colors and narrative role. Funnel-equipped all-range attacks remain the defining combat concept, placing the Mk-II within the wider Axis Newtype weapons program.

kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Look for the defining V-fin head, chest vents, contrasting red-and-blue torso and Federation shield. This is the classic RX-78-2 design; the grade and release year distinguish this kit from the many other model interpretations. When comparing editions, pay attention to proportions, surface paneling, joint design and how the core weapons are represented.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: The original Gundam piloted by Amuro Ray, reinterpreted across numerous Gunpla grades.
kits.lore: The RX-78-2 is the prototype Earth Federation mobile suit piloted by Amuro Ray during the One Year War. Designed under Project V, it demonstrates how a high-performance mobile suit can change the balance of a conflict dominated by the Principality of Zeon. Its beam rifle, beam sabers and shield became visual signatures of the Gundam line, while Amuro’s growing ability as a pilot gives the machine a central place in Universal Century history. Later Gundam designs repeatedly refer back to its configuration and combat record.
highlights: Iconic Federation shield and beam rifle
Distinct releases vary in surface detail and proportions

kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The-O combines broad yellow armor, thick legs, large skirt sections and a surprisingly small head. Its hidden sub-arms are an important identity feature; check how a particular kit represents them. The machine’s bulk makes balance and support more relevant to display planning than its seemingly simple weapon silhouette suggests.
kits.summary: Paptimus Scirocco’s massive, highly responsive mobile suit from Zeta Gundam.
kits.lore: The PMX-003 The-O is Paptimus Scirocco’s personal machine in Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam. Designed around extreme responsiveness and close-quarters combat, it appears massive and heavily armored despite emphasizing control in the hands of its exceptionally capable pilot. Its hidden sub-arms create unexpected possibilities in melee combat. The-O takes a central role in the final battles of the Gryps Conflict.

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Alex models can be identified by the white-and-blue Federation scheme and their variant armor treatment. Chobham armor changes the silhouette dramatically, but whether it is included depends on the exact release. The NT-1 should not be confused with the earlier RX-78-2 despite their common design lineage.
kits.summary: The RX-78NT-1 Alex tested at Side 6 in War in the Pocket.
kits.lore: The RX-78NT-1 Gundam Alex is a Federation prototype created for Newtype-oriented operation during the One Year War. In War in the Pocket it is tested by Christina Mackenzie, and its development is central to the conflict around Side 6. Its distinctive appearance can be augmented by Chobham armor, contrasting the slim prototype with an armored protective configuration.
highlights: War in the Pocket story role

kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Tallgeese III’s Mega Cannon, shield-mounted heat rod and modified head design are its most recognizable distinctions from the original Tallgeese. The exact contents and support arrangements depend on the kit edition. Standard Tallgeese and Tallgeese II entries should remain separate.
kits.summary: The upgraded Tallgeese associated with Endless Waltz.
kits.lore: Tallgeese III is an advanced machine associated with Milliardo Peacecraft in Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz. It draws from the Tallgeese lineage but introduces significant weapons and styling changes, making it a separate configuration rather than a simple repaint. Its striking head crest and powerful equipment reinforce its role in the final conflict.

kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large combined Striker pack, heavy sword and long-range cannon are essential identifiers. A Perfect Strike product is not the same as an ordinary Strike Gundam kit, which may omit some or all of the additional equipment.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Real Grade uses 1/144 scale with an emphasis on layered surface detail and mechanical interpretation. Assembly methods and articulation vary by production year.
kits.summary: A heavily armed Strike Gundam configuration combining multiple Striker systems.
kits.lore: Perfect Strike Gundam is a configuration of the GAT-X105 Strike Gundam associated with the combination of the Aile, Sword and Launcher Striker systems in Gundam SEED. The Strike was originally intended to adapt to different missions by exchanging its equipment; the Perfect Strike combines their functions into a heavily armed form. Its silhouette is crowded with equipment compared with the standard Strike Gundam.
highlights: Combined Aile, Sword and Launcher equipment

kits.summary: The experimental EXAM-equipped Federation machine from The Blue Destiny.
kits.lore: The RX-79BD-1 Blue Destiny Unit 1 features in the One Year War side-story game The Blue Destiny. Its story is built around the EXAM System, an experimental combat technology that places extraordinary strain on its users. Yuu Kajima becomes closely associated with the machine, whose GM-like head conceals performance and danger unusual for a conventional Federation unit.

The design reflects the organization’s changing technology and the demands of fighting powerful new enemies.

kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Seravee kits emphasize broad armor, prominent cannon structures and a strong heavy-unit stance. The relationship between Seravee and Seraphim is central to the design, but whether both are represented and how they connect depends on the edition. Do not apply this base description to the Scheherazade Build-series reinterpretation.
kits.summary: Tieria’s heavy-firepower Gundam from the second season of Gundam 00.
kits.lore: GN-008 Seravee Gundam is Tieria Erde’s heavy-support machine in the second season of Mobile Suit Gundam 00. Its broad body houses extensive GN weaponry, emphasizing defensive power and fire support rather than the speed of Arios. Seravee also carries a major surprise connected with its companion Gundam Seraphim, tying the design to Celestial Being’s unusual tactical systems.

kits.summary: Suletta Mercury’s GUND-ARM mobile suit from The Witch from Mercury.
kits.lore: Gundam Aerial is piloted by Suletta Mercury at Asticassia School of Technology in The Witch from Mercury. It is associated with the GUND Format and uses detachable GUND-BIT units that can act as remote weapons or combine into a defensive shield. Aerial’s seemingly unusual responsiveness is a central mystery of the series. Its battles are tied not only to school duels but also to questions of corporate control, medical technology and the costs of treating people as components of military systems.

kits.summary: Kio Asuno’s combining AGE-3 Normal from Gundam AGE.

Orbital and Fortress configurations use different equipment and should not be confused with the standard Normal form.

Its deployment reflects the rising stakes and shifting loyalties of the later Cosmic Era war.

kits.summary: Heero’s first Operation Meteor Gundam, noted for Bird Mode.
kits.lore: Wing Gundam is Heero Yuy’s primary machine early in Gundam Wing. Built for Operation Meteor, it combines a humanoid combat mode with a Bird Mode designed for high-speed atmospheric movement. The machine’s large Buster Rifle and green chest sensor become hallmarks of the series, while its role in the early struggle between the colonies, OZ and the Earth Sphere Alliance sets up the conflicts that follow.

kits.summary: Garrod Ran’s Twin Satellite Cannon Gundam from After War Gundam X.
kits.lore: The GX-9901-DX Gundam Double X is Garrod Ran’s upgraded mobile suit in After War Gundam X. Developed around satellite-cannon technology, its silhouette features large reflector assemblies that open to support the Twin Satellite Cannon. Its place in the story is inseparable from the postwar world’s conflict over the use and fear of devastating weapons.

kits.name: GUNDAM F91
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The F91 stands apart from earlier Gundams through its comparatively compact proportions, shoulder and backpack weapons and face-open design. Its VSBRs are crucial to identification; compare their placement across kit grades. Harrison Madin colors and other variants should be distinguished from the standard Seabook-era configuration.
kits.summary: Seabook Arno’s advanced SNRI Gundam from Gundam F91.
kits.lore: The Gundam F91 is an advanced Federation mobile suit developed by SNRI in the later Universal Century. Seabook Arno becomes its pilot during the events of the Gundam F91 film, confronting the Crossbone Vanguard. Its compact body houses sophisticated equipment, including the pair of VSBR weapons, while its high-performance operation is associated with striking afterimages.

aliases: HGCC 1/144 WD-M01 ターンエーガンダム
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Turn A models have a radically different head shape, rounded surfaces and unusual chest construction compared with typical V-fin Gundams. The Moonlight Butterfly effect is associated with the fictional unit; a model’s physical effect parts, if any, depend on the edition. Treat Turn A and the Turn X as separate machines.
kits.summary: Loran Cehack’s ancient Gundam, central to the story of ∀ Gundam.
kits.lore: Turn A Gundam is an enigmatic ancient mobile suit discovered in the world of ∀ Gundam. Loran Cehack pilots it amid the conflict between Earth’s people and the returning Moonrace. The machine’s unusual moustache-like facial crest and its connection to the buried history of technology make it one of the most distinctive Gundam designs. Its Moonlight Butterfly system carries enormous narrative significance.

aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Re-GZ presents a streamlined white-and-blue Federation shape, with design cues linking it to Zeta Gundam. The Back Weapon System is central to the mobile suit’s identity, but included display parts vary between kits. Keep standard Re-GZ editions separate from the Re-GZ Custom and other later variations.
kits.summary: A Zeta-derived Federation mobile suit used in Char’s Counterattack.
kits.lore: The RGZ-91 Re-GZ is a Federation transformable mobile suit from Mobile Suit Gundam: Char’s Counterattack, piloted most notably by Amuro Ray before his return to the ν Gundam. Its name abbreviates Refined Gundam Zeta, reflecting design ideas inherited from the Zeta line. Rather than performing a complete transformation alone, the machine uses a detachable Back Weapon System to provide its flight configuration.

kits.name: SAZABI
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Sazabi’s defining model features are its bulky red armor, funnel equipment, large shoulder structures and extensive rear thruster area. The Ver.Ka and RG interpretations have very different approaches to panel lines and engineering. When identifying a release, distinguish a standard Sazabi from special editions such as the MSN-04FF.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Char Aznable’s red Newtype mobile suit from Char’s Counterattack.
kits.lore: Sazabi is Char Aznable’s personal mobile suit in Char’s Counterattack. The massive red machine is designed to exploit the abilities of a Newtype pilot, combining substantial armor and powerful thrusters with funnel remote weapons. Its confrontation with Amuro Ray’s ν Gundam gives the final act of the film much of its emotional weight. Sazabi symbolizes Char’s return to open conflict over humanity’s future on Earth and in space.
highlights: Distinct RG, MG and special-edition interpretations

aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 逆襲のシャア
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Jegan models feature a mint-green armor palette, a squared visor head and compact Federation equipment. Numerous successor and mission variants exist, including D Type, A Type and later-era color schemes. Check the product title before assuming an ordinary Jegan and a later modified Jegan use the same armor.
kits.summary: The Federation’s long-serving mass-production mobile suit from Char’s Counterattack onward.
kits.lore: The RGM-89 Jegan becomes a major Earth Federation mass-production mobile suit after the Gryps Conflict. It is prominent in Char’s Counterattack and continues to appear, in upgraded forms, across later Universal Century stories. Its design emphasizes reliable deployment and standardized equipment rather than a Gundam prototype’s exceptional performance.

kits.name: ZZ GUNDAM
aliases: HGUC 1/144 ダブルゼータガンダム
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The ZZ design is more heavily built than the Zeta Gundam, with substantial shoulder and leg armor and a distinctive forehead cannon. Different grades vary in how they realize transformation and combination. A standard ZZ, Enhanced ZZ and Full Armor ZZ are not interchangeable catalog entries.
kits.summary: Judau Ashta’s high-firepower transformable Gundam in Gundam ZZ.
kits.lore: The MSZ-010 ZZ Gundam becomes Judau Ashta’s principal machine during Mobile Suit Gundam ZZ. It continues the transformable Gundam lineage while taking the concept toward greater firepower. Its combination system allows the machine to divide into components, and the powerful high-mega cannon in its forehead is one of its signature weapons. The ZZ is central to the AEUG’s struggle against the renewed Neo Zeon threat.

kits.name: GUNDAM GP01-Fb
aliases: 機動戦士ガンダム 0083 STARDUST MEMORY
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Full Burnern models are readily identified by their enlarged rear thruster system and different leg and backpack forms. Treat GP01 and GP01-Fb as separate catalog variants; the differences go beyond a paint change. When comparing kits, examine the treatment of the prominent boosters and the revised proportions.
kits.summary: The GP01’s space-adapted Full Burnern configuration.
kits.lore: The GP01 Full Burnern is the space-combat refit of Kou Uraki’s GP01 in Gundam 0083: Stardust Memory. After the earlier configuration proves unsuitable for its new operational setting, the prototype receives substantial thruster and mobility changes. Its resulting silhouette emphasizes high-speed movement in space while retaining the identity of the original Zephyranthes.

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Legend’s dark gray and blue accents, broad backpack and remote-weapon silhouette set it apart from standard frontline Gundams. Its DRAGOON equipment is key to the design, though the way deployed weapons can be displayed differs among releases. Avoid confusing it with Providence despite their shared remote-weapon concepts.
kits.summary: Rey Za Burrel’s DRAGOON-equipped Gundam in SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X666S Legend Gundam appears in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny and is piloted by Rey Za Burrel. It employs a DRAGOON remote-weapon system, reflecting Cosmic Era interest in all-range combat. Legend’s appearance contributes to the conflicts surrounding the Destiny Plan and ZAFT’s final military operations.

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Sinanju’s gold-on-red Sleeves ornamentation, complex curved armor and substantial backpack are defining display details. Consider how a kit renders the trim and its long weapon silhouettes. Sinanju Stein and recolored Build-series machines are different releases and should not automatically inherit standard Sinanju-specific modeling notes.
kits.summary: Full Frontal’s ornate red command mobile suit in Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: The MSN-06S Sinanju is Full Frontal’s red command mobile suit in Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn. Its exceptional mobility, elaborate gold markings and heavy equipment support the masked leader of the Neo Zeon remnants known as the Sleeves. Its rivalry with the Unicorn Gundam gives the machine a prominent role in the struggle over Laplace’s Box.

kits.summary: The RX-78NT-1 Alex tested at Side 6 in War in the Pocket.
kits.lore: The RX-78NT-1 Gundam Alex is a Federation prototype created for Newtype-oriented operation during the One Year War. In War in the Pocket it is tested by Christina Mackenzie, and its development is central to the conflict around Side 6. Its distinctive appearance can be augmented by Chobham armor, contrasting the slim prototype with an armored protective configuration.

kits.name: RICK-DOM
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The large skirt armor, bell-shaped legs and imposing torso make Rick Dom visually distinct from slender Zeon suits. The model is a space-use Rick Dom, not simply the terrestrial Dom with a different label.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: The space-adapted Dom mobile suit from the One Year War.
kits.lore: Rick Dom is a space-adapted development of the Zeon Dom family during the One Year War of Mobile Suit Gundam. In contrast to the ground-operating Dom, its equipment and mobility systems are adapted to space combat, and it serves alongside other mass-produced Zeon units against Federation forces. Its broad purple-and-black silhouette is among the era’s signature designs.

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Ez8 has a distinctive forehead and chest armor arrangement, subdued military styling and revised front silhouette. Do not treat it as a simple recolor of the Ground Type. Check the exact kit for its weapon and backpack configuration, which can vary between editions.
kits.summary: Shiro Amada’s rebuilt Ground Type Gundam from The 08th MS Team.
kits.lore: The RX-79[G]Ez-8 is Shiro Amada’s repaired and heavily modified Gundam Ground Type in The 08th MS Team. Built with available field resources after major damage, it reflects the series’ grounded depiction of mobile suit warfare. Its unconventional chest and head details and altered armor distinguish it from a standard production Ground Type.

kits.summary: The fast Zeon assault unit from War in the Pocket.
kits.lore: The MS-18E Kämpfer is a Zeon assault mobile suit used in Mobile Suit Gundam 0080: War in the Pocket. Mikhail Kaminsky pilots it during the operation against the Federation’s secret Gundam development effort. Designed for a rapid, high-impact strike, the Kämpfer favors mobility and a striking array of carried weapons over prolonged defensive combat.

kits.summary: Amuro Ray’s Fin Funnel-equipped Gundam from Char’s Counterattack.
kits.lore: Amuro Ray pilots the RX-93 ν Gundam in Char’s Counterattack. Developed rapidly to confront Char’s Neo Zeon forces, the machine incorporates Psycommu-related technology and the distinctive Fin Funnels, which can provide both attack and protection. Its confrontation with Sazabi is the climactic mobile suit duel of the film and a key event in the Universal Century timeline. The design combines the familiar Federation Gundam face with an asymmetric backpack of remote weapons.

kits.summary: Haman Karn’s funnel-equipped Newtype mobile suit from Zeta Gundam and Gundam ZZ.
kits.lore: The AMX-004 Qubeley is a Newtype-use machine associated with Haman Karn and the Axis forces in Zeta Gundam and Gundam ZZ. Its remote-controlled funnels, curved armor and broad shoulder binders create a silhouette unlike the Federation’s conventional mobile suits. Haman’s ability to employ the Psycommu-controlled weapons makes the Qubeley a formidable opponent. Later Qubeley Mk-II units use related technology but belong to different pilots and must not be mistaken for the original.

MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The wings and layered backpack give Freedom a broad outline even at smaller scales. Its distinctive equipment includes shoulder cannons, railguns and beam armaments. kits.summary: Kira Yamato’s winged, multi-target combat Gundam from Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: Freedom Gundam is a ZAFT-built high-performance mobile suit that becomes Kira Yamato’s principal machine during the later stages of Gundam SEED. Powered by a nuclear reactor, it combines extreme mobility with powerful multi-target ranged attacks. The spread of its wings, shoulder-mounted cannons and railguns makes it one of the series’ most recognizable silhouettes. Its presence changes the balance of the Earth Alliance–PLANT conflict and reflects Kira’s growing opposition to a war driven by cycles of retaliation.

kits.summary: M’Quve’s close-combat Zeon prototype from the original Gundam.
kits.lore: The YMS-15 Gyan is an experimental Zeon mobile suit associated with M’Quve in the original Mobile Suit Gundam. Unlike the more balanced Gelgoog, its striking design emphasizes close-quarters combat. M’Quve’s use of the machine gives its appearances a distinctive duelist character rather than the mass-production military role of a regular Zaku.

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
A Hyaku-Shiki model is defined by its gold surfaces, distinctive narrow head and rear binders. Metallic coatings, painted gold and ordinary molded finishes can look very different, even when the underlying machine is the same. Keep the standard Hyaku-Shiki separate from Hyaku-Shiki Kai and custom Build-series variants when comparing products.
kits.summary: The AEUG’s gold mobile suit piloted by Quattro Bajeena.
kits.lore: The golden MSN-00100 Hyaku-Shiki is a prototype mobile suit used by the AEUG during the Gryps Conflict. Quattro Bajeena, Char Aznable operating under an assumed identity, becomes its best-known pilot. Its development is connected to the Delta Gundam design line, and it favors mobility and skilled piloting over a conventional Gundam face. The machine is particularly memorable for its gold armor and its appearances alongside the Zeta Gundam and Gundam Mk-II.

ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The gold frame and large DRAGOON-equipped wings are essential visual details. Model-kit editions vary substantially: MGEX focuses on its multi-layered gold-frame presentation, whereas PG and other grades differ in size and construction. Judge details and display capabilities by the specific release rather than assuming accessories carry across editions.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Kira’s advanced, gold-framed mobile suit from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: Strike Freedom Gundam is Kira Yamato’s advanced machine in Gundam SEED Destiny, designed for tremendous mobility and simultaneous attacks against multiple opponents. Its wing assemblies carry DRAGOON remote weapons, while its gold-colored frame and high-output beam armaments create an unmistakable appearance. The suit is closely associated with Kira’s effort to intervene in the renewed Cosmic Era conflict without simply becoming another instrument of the escalating war.

kits.name: ZETA GUNDAM
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The elongated shield and wing binders are essential to Zeta’s Waverider configuration. Ver.Ka and other grades interpret the complex transformation differently, so the edition’s actual conversion steps should be checked before handling. The model’s appeal comes from the relationship between mobile suit proportions and its aircraft-like form.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
High Grade generally emphasizes a manageable build size and recognizable exterior forms at 1/144 scale. Specific articulation and accessories depend on the release.
kits.summary: Kamille’s transforming AEUG Gundam from Zeta Gundam.
kits.lore: Zeta Gundam is Kamille Bidan’s signature transformable mobile suit in Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam. Developed for the AEUG, it combines a fast-moving Waverider configuration with high-performance mobile suit combat. Its biography is closely tied to Kamille’s growth, the Gryps Conflict and the tensions between the Earth Federation, Titans and anti-Titans forces. The transformation becomes a defining feature of later variable-geometry Gundam designs.

kits.summary: A ground-combat Federation Gundam associated with The 08th MS Team.
kits.lore: The RX-79[G] Gundam Ground Type is a limited-production Earth Federation machine used for ground combat during the One Year War. It appears prominently in The 08th MS Team, where Shiro Amada leads a team operating in difficult terrestrial conditions. Unlike the iconic RX-78-2, these machines emphasize practical field deployment, maintenance and cooperation with other ground units.

kits.summary: A white-armored Sinanju-line mobile suit seen in Gundam Narrative.
kits.lore: Sinanju Stein represents the development lineage behind the red Sinanju. The Narrative version appears in Gundam Narrative in connection with Zoltan Akkanen and the Neo Zeon remnant forces. Its paler, straighter-edged armor makes it visibly different from Full Frontal’s highly ornamented red machine. Version labels matter, because Unicorn and Narrative interpretations are not necessarily the same depicted configuration.

kits.summary: Shinn Asuka’s multi-role Gundam from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X42S Destiny Gundam appears in Gundam SEED Destiny as the signature advanced machine of Shinn Asuka. It combines multiple combat roles in one platform: close-combat equipment, ranged weapons and high-speed maneuvering systems. Its deployment reflects the rising stakes and shifting loyalties of the later Cosmic Era war.

kits.summary: Athrun’s original Fatum-equipped partner unit to Freedom Gundam.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X09A Justice Gundam is a powerful ZAFT-developed machine in the original Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, piloted by Athrun Zala. Its Fatum-00 lifter enables high mobility and supports its role alongside Kira Yamato’s Freedom Gundam. Athrun’s choices in the final conflict turn the Justice into a symbol of resistance to escalating violence rather than simply another ZAFT weapon.

kits.summary: Marida Cruz’s four-binder Neo Zeon mobile suit from Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: The NZ-666 Kshatriya is a heavily armed Neo Zeon machine operated by Marida Cruz in Gundam Unicorn. Kshatriya’s battles showcase Marida’s skill and the harsh legacy of Newtype experimentation within the Universal Century.

kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Mk-II retains the striking shoulder binders and curved armored form of the original Qubeley. Color and edition information are vital: Elpeo Ple and Ple Two versions should be treated as distinct kit releases where appropriate. Do not apply the white original Qubeley’s artwork or markings to a Mk-II by default.
kits.summary: A successor Qubeley used by different Newtype pilots in Gundam ZZ.
kits.lore: Qubeley Mk-II machines are derived from the original Qubeley and appear in Gundam ZZ under different Newtype pilots, including Elpeo Ple and Ple Two. Although related to Haman Karn’s original mobile suit, each machine has its own colors and narrative role. Funnel-equipped all-range attacks remain the defining combat concept, placing the Mk-II within the wider Axis Newtype weapons program.

kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
The wings and layered backpack give Freedom a broad outline even at smaller scales. Its distinctive equipment includes shoulder cannons, railguns and beam armaments. Differing grades and later redesigns can have different proportions and engineering; do not confuse the original Freedom with Strike Freedom, Rising Freedom or Mighty Strike Freedom.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: Kira Yamato’s winged, multi-target combat Gundam from Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: Freedom Gundam is a ZAFT-built high-performance mobile suit that becomes Kira Yamato’s principal machine during the later stages of Gundam SEED. Powered by a nuclear reactor, it combines extreme mobility with powerful multi-target ranged attacks. The spread of its wings, shoulder-mounted cannons and railguns makes it one of the series’ most recognizable silhouettes. Its presence changes the balance of the Earth Alliance–PLANT conflict and reflects Kira’s growing opposition to a war driven by cycles of retaliation.

kits.name: GUNDAM LEOPARD
aliases: HG 1/144 ガンダムレオパルド
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Gundam Leopard’s solid armor, dark green palette and heavy weapon systems establish an artillery-centered silhouette. It is distinct from the Leopard Destroy upgrade and Build-series custom versions. Kits from different lines may differ considerably in weapon mounting and display possibilities.
kits.summary: Roabea Loy’s heavy-firepower Gundam from After War Gundam X.
kits.lore: The GT-9600 Gundam Leopard from After War Gundam X is piloted by Roabea Loy, one of the Freeden’s mobile suit pilots. Its weapons and heavy armor support sustained ground firepower, complementing the more agile Gundam X and Airmaster within the group. Its presence helps define the variety of surviving Gundam technology in the postwar After War era.

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Gyan models center on a narrow helmet-like head, a fencing-style beam saber and an unusual rounded shield design. The relatively slim torso and broad leg armor give it a unique silhouette. Do not confuse the original Gyan with Gyan Strom or Build-series reinterpretations.
kits.summary: M’Quve’s close-combat Zeon prototype from the original Gundam.
kits.lore: The YMS-15 Gyan is an experimental Zeon mobile suit associated with M’Quve in the original Mobile Suit Gundam. Unlike the more balanced Gelgoog, its striking design emphasizes close-quarters combat. M’Quve’s use of the machine gives its appearances a distinctive duelist character rather than the mass-production military role of a regular Zaku.

kits.summary: Kira’s advanced, gold-framed mobile suit from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: Strike Freedom Gundam is Kira Yamato’s advanced machine in Gundam SEED Destiny, designed for tremendous mobility and simultaneous attacks against multiple opponents. Its wing assemblies carry DRAGOON remote weapons, while its gold-colored frame and high-output beam armaments create an unmistakable appearance. The suit is closely associated with Kira’s effort to intervene in the renewed Cosmic Era conflict without simply becoming another instrument of the escalating war.

kits.name: ∀ GUNDAM
aliases: MG 1/100 WD-M01 ターンエーガンダム
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Turn A models have a radically different head shape, rounded surfaces and unusual chest construction compared with typical V-fin Gundams. The Moonlight Butterfly effect is associated with the fictional unit; a model’s physical effect parts, if any, depend on the edition. Treat Turn A and the Turn X as separate machines.
kits.summary: Loran Cehack’s ancient Gundam, central to the story of ∀ Gundam.
kits.lore: Turn A Gundam is an enigmatic ancient mobile suit discovered in the world of ∀ Gundam. Loran Cehack pilots it amid the conflict between Earth’s people and the returning Moonrace. The machine’s unusual moustache-like facial crest and its connection to the buried history of technology make it one of the most distinctive Gundam designs. Its Moonlight Butterfly system carries enormous narrative significance.

aliases: MG 1/100 ユニコーンガンダム Ver.Ka
kits.notes:
ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
MORE ABOUT THIS RELEASE
Unicorn model kits are distinguished by their transformation between restrained white armor and an expanded Destroy Mode silhouette. How that transformation is realized varies significantly with grade. Do not confuse Unicorn with Banshee, Phenex or the later Full Armor configurations.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: Banagher’s transforming psycho-frame Gundam from Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: RX-0 Unicorn Gundam is a prototype mobile suit central to the events of Gundam Unicorn. Banagher Links becomes its pilot, and its hidden capabilities are tied to the Laplace’s Box conflict and the possibility of a different future for the Universal Century. Unicorn’s transformation from a white Unicorn Mode into the exposed psycho-frame Destroy Mode makes its appearance a metaphor for the latent power and dangers of Newtype technology.

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
Destiny’s striking V-fin, red wing elements and large sword silhouette make it suited to dynamic posing. Expanded wings and combat-effect imagery are important to its identity, but availability differs between normal and special-edition kits. Distinguish Destiny from the later Destiny Spec II interpretation.
kits.summary: Shinn Asuka’s multi-role Gundam from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X42S Destiny Gundam appears in Gundam SEED Destiny as the signature advanced machine of Shinn Asuka. It combines multiple combat roles in one platform: close-combat equipment, ranged weapons and high-speed maneuvering systems. Its deployment reflects the rising stakes and shifting loyalties of the later Cosmic Era war.

Infinite Justice is recognizable by its vivid pink-red armor and the Fatum-01 lifter. Leg-mounted beam weapon themes give it a different silhouette and combat presentation from the earlier Justice. Do not mix it with the Infinite Justice Type II, whose updated design belongs to a later story.
kits.summary: Athrun’s upgraded Justice Gundam from SEED Destiny.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X19A Infinite Justice Gundam is Athrun Zala’s advanced successor to the original Justice in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED Destiny. It maintains the mobile suit’s characteristic high-mobility flight equipment while bringing a stronger close-combat emphasis to the final conflict. It forms a memorable pairing with Kira’s Strike Freedom in the story’s late battles.

kits.name: SINANJU
kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Sinanju’s gold-on-red Sleeves ornamentation, complex curved armor and substantial backpack are defining display details. Consider how a kit renders the trim and its long weapon silhouettes. Sinanju Stein and recolored Build-series machines are different releases and should not automatically inherit standard Sinanju-specific modeling notes.
kits.summary: Full Frontal’s ornate red command mobile suit in Gundam Unicorn.
kits.lore: The MSN-06S Sinanju is Full Frontal’s red command mobile suit in Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn. Its exceptional mobility, elaborate gold markings and heavy equipment support the masked leader of the Neo Zeon remnants known as the Sleeves. Its rivalry with the Unicorn Gundam gives the machine a prominent role in the struggle over Laplace’s Box.

Exia is identified by its angular white armor, green GN condenser elements and asymmetrical GN Sword. Its blade-focused equipment separates it from Dynames, Kyrios and Virtue. Exia, Exia Repair and Exia Repair II should be treated as distinct editions when choosing model details and accessories.

GRADE & BUILD CONTEXT
Master Grade at 1/100 scale typically emphasizes a more involved build and greater mechanical detail. The inner structure and accessories vary between versions.
kits.summary: Setsuna’s original Seven Swords mobile suit from Gundam 00.
kits.lore: The GN-001 Gundam Exia is one of Celestial Being’s original Gundams in Gundam 00, piloted by Setsuna F. Seiei. Powered by a GN Drive, it specializes in close combat and carries multiple blades, leading to its Seven Swords design concept. Exia is central to Celestial Being’s armed interventions and to Setsuna’s personal understanding of what a Gundam represents. It later undergoes major repairs and modifications following the first season’s battles.

kits.summary: Heero’s first Operation Meteor Gundam, noted for Bird Mode.
kits.lore: Wing Gundam is Heero Yuy’s primary machine early in Gundam Wing. Built for Operation Meteor, it combines a humanoid combat mode with a Bird Mode designed for high-speed atmospheric movement. The machine’s large Buster Rifle and green chest sensor become hallmarks of the series, while its role in the early struggle between the colonies, OZ and the Earth Sphere Alliance sets up the conflicts that follow.

The large black active cloak assemblies are key to displaying Deathscythe Hell EW. Compare their folded and opened shapes when selecting poses. A standard Deathscythe, television Deathscythe Hell and Endless Waltz Deathscythe Hell are separate visual designs.
kits.summary: Duo Maxwell’s cloak-equipped Deathscythe Hell from Endless Waltz.
kits.lore: Gundam Deathscythe Hell appears in its Endless Waltz form as Duo Maxwell’s close-range machine. Compared with the earlier Deathscythe design, its cloak-like active cloak armor and winged silhouette reinforce its association with stealth and sudden attack. Its signature beam scythe evokes the grim-reaper imagery that characterizes Duo’s Gundam.

MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The-O combines broad yellow armor, thick legs, large skirt sections and a surprisingly small head. Its hidden sub-arms are an important identity feature; check how a particular kit represents them. The machine’s bulk makes balance and support more relevant to display planning than its seemingly simple weapon silhouette suggests.
kits.summary: Paptimus Scirocco’s massive, highly responsive mobile suit from Zeta Gundam.
kits.lore: The PMX-003 The-O is Paptimus Scirocco’s personal machine in Mobile Suit Zeta Gundam. Designed around extreme responsiveness and close-quarters combat, it appears massive and heavily armored despite emphasizing control in the hands of its exceptionally capable pilot. Its hidden sub-arms create unexpected possibilities in melee combat. The-O takes a central role in the final battles of the Gryps Conflict.

kits.summary: Flit Asuno’s adaptable first-generation Gundam from Gundam AGE.
kits.lore: Gundam AGE-1 is Flit Asuno’s mobile suit in the first generation of Gundam AGE. Developed around the AGE System, it uses an adaptive technology concept in which combat data can guide the creation of new equipment. AGE-1 has several specialized wear configurations, allowing the original Normal form to evolve for different battlefield demands. Its history anchors the series’ multi-generational narrative.

AGE-2 Normal kits are identified by their sharp shoulders, wing-like armor and white-blue palette. The later Dark Hound version changes the machine’s identity, colors and equipment, and should be kept separate. Verify the release’s actual transformation instructions rather than assuming identical gimmicks across grades.
kits.summary: Asemu Asuno’s transforming Gundam AGE-2 Normal.
kits.lore: The AGE-2 Gundam AGE-2 Normal becomes Asemu Asuno’s principal Gundam in Mobile Suit Gundam AGE. Its fast-moving transformable design contrasts with the AGE-1’s earlier configuration, reflecting the next stage in the Asuno family’s story. The AGE-2 combines a sharp wing-like profile with mobile suit and flight-oriented operation.

The Buster has an unusually heavy gun-platform silhouette, with long weapons and mounting hardware shaping its outline. This is a better reference for long-range posing than agile sword duels. Exact weapon connections and pose support vary among MG and HG editions.
kits.summary: A long-range support Gundam piloted by Dearka Elsman in Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: The GAT-X103 Buster Gundam is another Earth Alliance machine captured by ZAFT during the Heliopolis raid. Dearka Elsman pilots it as a long-range fire-support unit, using a high-energy rifle and gun launcher that can combine for specialized attacks. Its combat role contrasts with the sword-focused Blitz and versatile Duel in the original five GAT-X machines.

kits.notes:
MORE ABOUT THIS MODEL KIT
The Blitz has dark armor, angular limbs and a large multifunction shield-mounted weapon system. The aggressive black-purple silhouette contrasts sharply with the brighter Duel and Aegis. Any included effect parts and the execution of its stealth-oriented equipment depend on the specific release.
kits.summary: Nicol Amalfi’s stealth-focused GAT-X machine from Gundam SEED.
kits.lore: The GAT-X207 Blitz Gundam is a stolen Earth Alliance prototype piloted by Nicol Amalfi in Mobile Suit Gundam SEED. Its Mirage Colloid technology allows stealthy approaches that conventional mobile suits cannot easily counter. Nicol’s deployment of the Blitz becomes important in the escalating conflict between the Archangel crew and ZAFT pursuit forces.

kits.summary: The pirate-styled later configuration of Asemu Asuno’s AGE-2.
kits.lore: Gundam AGE-2 Dark Hound is the dramatically modified successor to the original AGE-2 used by Asemu Asuno under a new identity. Its dark pirate-inspired appearance reflects a different stage of the Gundam AGE story and a changed set of combat priorities. It should be treated as a distinct configuration rather than a simple alternate color of AGE-2 Normal.

kits.summary: A high-performance Londo Bell unit featured alongside the Unicorn Gundam.
kits.lore: The RGM-96X Jesta appears in Mobile Suit Gundam Unicorn as a high-performance Federation unit connected with Londo Bell and the Ra Cailum. Developed with support for special missions involving the Unicorn Gundam, it combines a subdued tactical appearance with the versatility expected of a modern general-purpose mobile suit. Its deployment underlines how conventional Federation forces operate alongside far more exceptional Newtype-use machines.

kits.summary: The asymmetric rival to Turn A Gundam in ∀ Gundam.
kits.lore: Turn X is a formidable machine associated with Gym Ghingnham in ∀ Gundam. It stands opposite the Turn A and shares connections to the story’s mysterious high-technology past. Its unusual asymmetric body and ability to separate components make it a striking antagonist design, while its relationship to the Moonlight Butterfly system gives its battles unusual scale.

kits.summary: Garrod Ran’s Twin Satellite Cannon Gundam from After War Gundam X.
kits.lore: The GX-9901-DX Gundam Double X is Garrod Ran’s upgraded mobile suit in After War Gundam X. Developed around satellite-cannon technology, its silhouette features large reflector assemblies that open to support the Twin Satellite Cannon. Its place in the story is inseparable from the postwar world’s conflict over the use and fear of devastating weapons.

kits.summary: Athrun’s original Fatum-equipped partner unit to Freedom Gundam.
kits.lore: The ZGMF-X09A Justice Gundam is a powerful ZAFT-developed machine in the original Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, piloted by Athrun Zala. Its Fatum-00 lifter enables high mobility and supports its role alongside Kira Yamato’s Freedom Gundam. Athrun’s choices in the final conflict turn the Justice into a symbol of resistance to escalating violence rather than simply another ZAFT weapon.
